title: Budget-Aware Compression Pipeline for Single-GPU LLM Inference: Methods, Trade-offs, and Coupling Effects
authors: Hongyu Yu, Yifei Shen
abstract: Single-GPU deployment of 70B-parameter language models on an NVIDIA GPU is constrained by device memory, long-context throughput, and engineering integration cost. We cast single-GPU inference as a budget-aware design problem over these three axes and study how pruning, quantization, and KV-cache compression interact under realistic execution. Controlled ablations show that layer-wise pruning makes weight quantization more robust. KV-cache sparsification complements INT8 KV quantization by reducing memory without hurting decoding speed, while static vector quantizers often conflict with dynamic caching. Guided by these coupling results and explicit budget tracking, we assembled a practical pipeline and compressed a 70B model to about 33 GB, sustained about 57 tokens/s on 10k token prompts on a single A40, and kept absolute accuracy within 5% on common and reasoning benchmarks. We contribute design rules and a reproducible evaluation protocol that jointly report quality, memory, and end-to-end speed, and we provide a foundation for automated pipeline search under realistic single-GPU constraints.
zh_title: 单GPU大模型推理的预算感知压缩流水线：方法、权衡与耦合效应
translation: 在NVIDIA GPU上单设备部署70B参数语言模型受到设备内存、长上下文吞吐量和工程集成成本的限制。我们将单GPU推理视为这三个维度的预算感知设计问题，并研究了在真实执行下剪枝、量化和KV缓存压缩如何相互作用。受控消融实验表明，层级剪枝使权重量化更加鲁棒。KV缓存稀疏化通过在不损害解码速度的情况下减少内存，与INT8 KV量化相辅相成，而静态向量量化常与动态缓存冲突。在这些耦合结果和显式预算追踪的指导下，我们组装了一个实用的流水线，将70B模型压缩至约33 GB，在单张A40上处理10k token提示词时维持了约57 tokens/s的吞吐量，并将常规和推理基准上的绝对精度保持在5%以内。我们贡献了设计规则和可复现的评估协议，联合报告了质量、内存和端到端速度，并为真实单GPU约束下的自动化流水线搜索奠定了基础。
tldr: 提出了一种面向单GPU大模型推理的预算感知压缩流水线，成功在单张A40上高效运行70B大模型。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了在单GPU受限环境下大语言模型（70B）压缩技术的耦合效应，填补了以往孤立研究单一压缩方法的空白，具有很高的工程落地价值。
motivation: 在单张GPU上部署70B参数的大语言模型受到设备内存、长文本吞吐量以及工程集成成本的严重限制，缺乏对多种压缩技术（剪枝、量化、KV缓存压缩）交互作用的系统研究。
method: 通过控制变量消融实验，研究了层级剪枝、权重量化和KV缓存压缩在真实执行中的交互与耦合效应，并组装了一个预算感知的实用压缩流水线。
results: 成功将70B模型压缩至约33 GB，在单张A40 GPU上处理10k token提示词时保持了约57 tokens/s的吞吐量，且在常规和推理基准上的绝对精度损失保持在5%以内。
conclusion: 该研究证明了通过精心设计的压缩流水线和权衡调优，单GPU高效运行70B大模型是完全可行的，并为自动化流水线搜索奠定了基础。

title: Tracing Generated Samples to Training-Data Clusters in Flow-Matching Models
authors: Rania Briq, Ohad Fried, Michael Kamp, Stefan Kesselheim
abstract:
Understanding which training samples influence a generated image is an important problem in generative modeling. In flow matching, training samples influence the generated image through the velocity field along the generation trajectory. Removing samples to examine their counterfactual influence changes the velocity field, and the resulting effect on the final image depends on how the change propagates through the trajectory. Consequently, local changes in the velocity field do not necessarily predict the final counterfactual effect.
  This work investigates attribution in flow-matching models through a hybrid analytical--learned approach, and uses it to derive trajectory-based attribution scores at the cluster level. We evaluate these attribution scores using independently retrained leave-one-cluster-out (LOO) models, and compare with several attribution baselines using two different flow-matching latent spaces. Our experiments show that semantic similarity constitutes a strong baseline, while the closed-form trajectory-based attribution is competitive in some metrics without requiring counterfactual retraining or model gradients.
  Our results show that attribution in flow matching depends not only on semantic similarity to training samples, but also on the latent representation, trajectory dynamics, and how influence is propagated to the final output.
zh_title: 在流匹配模型中将生成样本追溯到训练数据群集
translation:
理解哪些训练样本影响生成的图像是生成建模中的一个重要问题。在流匹配中，训练样本通过生成轨迹沿线的速度场影响生成的图像。移除样本以检查其反事实影响会改变速度场，其对最终图像的产生的影响取决于这种改变如何在轨迹中传播。因此，速度场的局部变化不一定能预测最终的反事实效果。
本工作通过混合的解析与学习方法研究了流匹配模型中的归因，并利用它推导了群集级别的基于轨迹的归因得分。我们使用独立重新训练的留一群集（LOO）模型对这些归因得分进行了评估，并在两个不同的流匹配潜在空间中与几种归因基线进行了比较。我们的实验表明，语义相似度构成了一个强有力的基线，而闭式基于轨迹的归因在某些指标上具有竞争力，且不需要反事实重新训练或模型梯度。
我们的结果表明，流匹配中的归因不仅取决于与训练样本的语义相似度，还取决于潜在表示、轨迹动力学以及影响力如何传播到最终输出。
tldr: 本文提出了一种针对流匹配模型的轨迹基归因方法，无需重新训练即可评估训练数据对生成样本的影响。
ai_comments: 该论文针对流匹配模型（Flow-Matching Models）中的生成样本溯源问题进行了创新性探讨，提出了结合解析与学习的混合方法，并实现了群集级别的轨迹归因得分，为理解生成模型中的数据影响力提供了新的视角和方法。
motivation: 理解训练样本如何影响生成的图像是生成建模中的一个重要问题，而流匹配中样本通过生成轨迹的速度场影响图像，局部速度场的变化并不必然能预测最终的反事实效果，因此需要研究更准确的轨迹基归因方法。
method: 提出了一种混合解析-学习方法，用于推导群集级别的轨迹基归因得分，并通过独立重新训练的留一群集（LOO）模型进行评估和基线对比。
results: 实验表明，语义相似度是一个强有力的基线，而闭式轨迹基归因在某些指标上具有竞争力，且无需反事实重新训练或模型梯度。
conclusion: 流匹配模型中的样本归因不仅依赖于训练样本的语义相似度，还深刻受到潜在表示、轨迹动力学以及影响力如何传播至最终输出的影响。

title: AMINA: The Inclusive and Accountable AI for Marginalized Immigrant Nonprofit Assistance
authors: Maryam Mokhberi, Dipto Das, Syed Ishtiaque Ahmed
abstract: Immigrant-led nonprofit groups, particularly those operating in politically sensitive contexts, face exclusion from formal registries and digital platforms. This paper reports a three-phase mixed-methods study with Iranian immigrant nonprofit practitioners: 27 semi-structured interviews, a co-design session, and 7 evaluation and feedback interviews on a prototyped AI assistant, AMINA. Our findings highlight how legitimacy barriers, capacity gaps, and politically charged misinformation constrain nonprofit operations. We translate these insights into design goals for an inclusive nonprofit AI assistant: support for everyday group operations, recognition of informal nonprofit efforts, proactive countering of misinformation, and multilingual, accessible interaction. User evaluations show AMINAs potential to reduce reporting burdens and foster transparency through proactive reminders, and catalyze collaboration across dispersed networks. We contribute to CSCW and HCI by characterizing the cooperative work of transnational immigrant nonprofits, extending scholarship on informality and misinformation, and demonstrating how AI can act as a collaborative partner that strengthens, rather than displaces, the human connections at the core of nonprofit ecosystems, while also posing major risks.
zh_title: AMINA：用于边缘化移民非营利组织援助的包容且负责任的人工智能
translation: 由移民领导的非营利组织，特别是那些在政治敏感背景下运作的组织，面临着被正式注册表和数字平台排除在外的困境。本文报告了一项针对伊朗移民非营利组织从业者的三阶段混合方法研究：27次半结构化访谈、一次共设计会议以及对AMINA这一人工智能原型助手的7次评估与反馈访谈。我们的研究结果突显了合法性壁垒、能力差距以及政治化错误信息如何制约非营利组织的运营。我们将这些见解转化为包容性非营利AI助手的设计目标：支持日常群体运营、认可非正式非营利工作、积极反击错误信息，以及提供多语言、无障碍的交互。用户评估显示了AMINA通过主动提醒减轻报告负担、通过主动提醒促进透明度、并促成分散网络间合作的潜力。我们通过刻画跨国移民非营利组织的协作工作、扩展关于非正式性与错误信息的学术研究，并展示人工智能如何作为协作伙伴来巩固（而非取代）非营利生态系统核心的人际连接（同时也带来重大风险），从而为CSCW和HCI领域做出了贡献。
tldr: 开发并评估了名为AMINA的AI助手，旨在帮助被边缘化的移民非营利组织克服合法性与运营壁垒，增强人际连接与协作。
ai_comments: 该研究聚焦于边缘化移民非营利组织的独特困境，创新性地提出了AMINA这一AI助手的设计与评估，为HCI和CSCW领域贡献了关于跨国、非正式组织协同工作的深刻见解。
motivation: 移民领导的非营利组织（尤其是在政治敏感背景下运营的组织）面临着被主流注册表和数字平台排除在外的困境，缺乏有效的技术与运营支持。
method: 采用三阶段混合方法研究，包括27次半结构化访谈、1次共设计工作坊以及对AMINA原型机的7次评估与反馈访谈。
results: 评估表明AMINA能够通过主动提醒减少报告负担、增强透明度，并促进分散网络之间的合作，同时该论文也指出了AI技术可能带来的重大风险。
conclusion: 本研究展示了AI作为协作伙伴在支持边缘化移民非营利组织方面的潜力与风险，为包容性和负责任的AI系统设计提供了重要启示。

title: When Does a Classifier Help an LLM? Classifier-Guided Prompting and Hybrid Classifier-LLM Models for Credit-Default Prediction
authors: Rishi Datta, Lavanya Prahallad
abstract: Credit-default prediction is an important task in financial decision making. Traditional methods use fitted classifiers such as logistic regression and random forests on tabular features. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been applied to this task through prompting. In this work we study how a fitted classifier and an LLM can be combined for credit-default prediction. We distinguish telling the LLM to imitate a classifier from using the classifier to build the prompt. We hypothesize that a fitted classifier can supply the ranking ability that an LLM prompt lacks. We experiment on the Default of Credit Card Clients dataset, and report recall, F1, and the area under the ROC and precision-recall curves, with bootstrap confidence intervals. We observe that a few-shot LLM has the highest recall (0.47) and F1 (0.50) of any single model but ranks worse than a random forest (AUC-ROC 0.72 against 0.79). Instructing the LLM to imitate a classifier gives no significant change. Pruning the prompt to the classifier's eight most important features raises recall by 0.071 and F1 by 0.032. Adding the classifier's predicted probability to the prompt raises the LLM's AUC-ROC from 0.72 to 0.78, matching the random forest, while keeping 0.118 higher recall than it. The reverse composition, and the use of several classifiers, do not help. We thus recommend a simple classifier-guided prompt for LLM-based credit prediction.

title: Zero-Knowledge Predicate Proofs Between AI Agents: A Measured, Cross-Protocol Gateway and the Source-Integrity Gap
authors: Ashok Subbabhatta Gopalakrishna
abstract: Multi-agent AI platforms move quickly from staging to production, but the way agents establish trust remains rudimentary: an agent either transmits raw data to a peer or accepts that peer's natural-language self-report that a value complies with policy. The first over-shares; the second is unverifiable and is exactly the channel prompt injection attacks. Prevailing responses emphasise identity, visibility, and post-hoc detection, and recent proposals for cryptographically enforced agent policy have been evaluated in simulation rather than execution. We take provable data minimisation between agents from proposal to running system. In our Zero-Knowledge Proof Gateway, agents exchange proofs of governance-defined predicates over private data rather than the data itself, so exposure is prevented by design rather than detected afterwards; because no interoperability protocol can carry such a proof, we propose a slot and implement it on both MCP and Agent2Agent from one endpoint. A 32-bit threshold predicate proves in 6.2 ms and verifies in 1.0 ms with a 608-byte Bulletproofs proof on one commodity vCPU; eleven adversarial experiments and nineteen protocol checks pass; and the system is deployed to Kubernetes with empirically verified network isolation. Our case study proves a retail client order is within its limit without revealing the amount, instantiating the GDPR data-minimisation principle as an enforced technical measure of the kind EU law now names explicitly. We then address the limitation no comparable work resolves: a predicate proof binds a statement to a committed value, never to the system of record. We give a construction fusing an enclave attestation with the proof in both directions, so verifying one artifact certifies jointly that the predicate holds and that the value was read by a specific measured binary, and test it against a mock authority.
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Reference implementation available at https://github.com/45h0kg/zk-proof-gateway
zh_title: AI智能体之间的零知识谓词证明：一种经测量的跨协议网关与源完整性鸿沟
translation: 多智能体AI平台正快速从测试阶段转向生产阶段，但智能体建立信任的方式仍然十分原始：智能体要么向对端传输原始数据，要么接受对端关于某个数值符合策略的自然语言自我报告。前者过度共享数据，后者无法验证且正是提示词注入攻击的渠道。目前普遍的应对措施强调身份、可见性以及事后检测，且近期关于密码学强制智能体策略的提议仅在仿真中进行评估，而非实际执行。我们将智能体之间可证明的数据最小化从概念提议推进到运行系统。在我们的零知识证明网关中，智能体交换基于私有数据的治理定义谓词证明，而不是数据本身，从而通过设计防止数据暴露而非事后检测；由于没有互操作协议能够承载此类证明，我们提出了一个扩展槽，并在MCP和Agent2Agent的单个端点上进行了实现。在单个通用vCPU上，一个32位阈值谓词的证明时间为6.2毫秒，验证时间为1.0毫秒，证明大小为608字节的Bulletproofs；通过了11个对抗实验和19个协议检查；系统已部署到具有经验证的网络隔离的Kubernetes中。我们的案例研究证明，在不透露具体金额的情况下，零售客户订单在其限额之内，从而将GDPR数据最小化原则实例化为欧盟法律现今明确指出的强制性技术措施。随后，我们解决了同类工作均未解决的限制：谓词证明将陈述绑定到一个已承诺的值，但从未绑定到记录系统。我们提出了一种将飞地证明与该证明双向融合的结构，因此验证单个工件即可共同证明该谓词成立且该值是由特定经测量的二进制读取的，并针对模拟权威进行了测试。
tldr: 提出了一种AI多智能体系统的零知识证明网关与源完整性方案，实现在保护隐私的同时进行可信的策略验证。
ai_comments: 该论文首次将零知识证明引入多智能体AI系统，不仅在实际协议中（MCP和Agent2Agent）进行了实现和性能评估，还创新性地通过安全飞地证明解决了“源完整性鸿沟”问题，具有很高的实用价值和前瞻性。
motivation: 当前多智能体AI平台中的信任机制非常原始，要么过度共享原始数据，要么信任易受提示词注入攻击的自然语言自我报告，缺乏真正的密码学策略强制和数据最小化机制。
method: 开发了一个零知识证明网关，在MCP和Agent2Agent协议中实现私有数据的治理谓词证明，并结合安全飞地（enclave attestation）实现双向融合的源完整性认证。
results: 实现了32位阈值谓词在单台通用vCPU上6.2ms内生成、1.0ms内验证（608字节Bulletproofs证明），通过了11项对抗实验和19项协议检查，并成功部署到Kubernetes。
conclusion: 论文通过零知识断言证明网关和飞地集成，成功解决了多智能体AI平台中的信任、隐私与源完整性问题，并具备优异的性能。

title: The Nearest Target Is the Wrong One: Target Separation in Arc2Face Identity Unlearning
authors: Zeynel Tok
abstract: Unlearning an identity from a face-conditioned generator by redirecting its conditioning embedding can silently fail if the redirected output is still verified as the original person. We show that this failure depends on a controllable choice of how far the redirection target lies from the forget identity in recognition space, and that the most intuitive target, the nearest neighbour, is the one most likely to cause it. We audit Arc2Face with a locked ArcFace protocol and a projection adapter that redirects identity conditioning before generation. On a hard-neighbour stress test built from the hardest 0.5% of eligible identities, four target-selection policies show a monotonic response: clean forgetting rises from 9/30 groups under the nearest hard target to 30/30 under the least similar one. Mean forget-identity re-identification falls from 51.9 to 0.0 while mean retention stays flat. This reflects successful redirection rather than outputs becoming unverifiable: 710 of 720 least-sim-hard generations arrive at the chosen target, with no leakage to unrelated identities. Re-verifying identical images with an independent recogniser (AdaFace) preserves that trend, correlating at r=0.94, arguing against a verifier artefact. Target separation is thus a first-order, reportable design variable for identity unlearning.
comment: 16 pages, accepted at the ECCV 2026 Workshop on Unlearning and Model Editing (U&ME)
zh_title: 最近的目标是错误的：Arc2Face 身份遗忘中的目标分离
translation: 通过重定向条件嵌入从面部条件生成器中遗忘一个身份，如果重定向后的输出仍然被验证为原人物，可能会悄然失效。我们发现，这种失效取决于重定向目标在识别空间中距离遗忘身份有多远的受控选择，并且最直观的目标——最近邻，是最可能导致失效的目标。我们使用锁定的 ArcFace 协议和在生成前重定向身份条件的投影适配器对 Arc2Face 进行了审计。在由最困难的 0.5% 合格身份构建的困难邻居压力测试中，四种目标选择策略显示出单调的响应：干净遗忘从最近困难目标的 9/30 组上升到最不相似目标的 30/30 组。平均遗忘身份重新识别率从 51.9 下降到 0.0，而平均保留率保持平稳。这反映了成功的重定向，而不是输出变得无法验证：720 个最不相似困难生成中有 710 个到达了所选目标，且没有泄漏到不相关的身份。使用独立识别器（AdaFace）重新验证相同图像保持了这一趋势，相关性为 r=0.94，排除了验证器伪影的可能性。因此，目标分离是身份遗忘的一个一阶、可报告的设计变量。
tldr: 在面部生成器的身份遗忘中，选择最近邻作为目标往往会导致遗忘失败，而选择距离较远的非相似目标才能实现成功且干净的身份遗忘。
ai_comments: 该论文揭示了面部条件生成器身份遗忘中的一个关键现象：选择最近的目标（如最近邻）往往无法有效遗忘身份，而选择距离较远的目标能实现干净的遗忘。这为身份遗忘技术的设计提供了重要的理论和实证依据。
motivation: 通过重定向条件嵌入来从面部条件生成器中遗忘身份时，如果重定向的输出仍然被验证为原始人物，可能会悄然失败。论文旨在探讨这种失败与重定向目标在识别空间中距离的关系。
method: 使用锁定的 ArcFace 协议和投影适配器审计 Arc2Face，并在由最难 0.5% 的符合条件身份构建的困难邻居压力测试上，评估了四种目标选择策略。
results: 随着重定向目标与遗忘身份相似度的降低，干净遗忘的成功率从 9/30 组上升到 30/30 组；平均遗忘身份重新识别率从 51.9 下降到 0.0，而平均保留率保持平稳。独立识别器（AdaFace）验证也呈现出高度的一致性（r=0.94）。
conclusion: 目标分离是身份遗忘中的一个重要设计变量。通过选择相似度低的目标，可以实现有效且干净的身份遗忘，同时保持其他身份的保留。

title: A Lightweight Phenology-Aware YOLOv5 Framework for Tomato Growth Stage Detection in Resource-Constrained Bhutanese Greenhouse Environments
authors: Sherab Gocha, Sou Nobukawa
abstract: Accurate detection of tomato growth stages is essential for stage-specific greenhouse management and precision agriculture. In Bhutan, greenhouse cultivation is affected by altitude variability, large diurnal temperature fluctuations, diffuse illumination, limited automation, and a scarcity of locally annotated datasets, limiting the applicability of conventional deep learning models. This work proposes Pheno-Lite + Efficient Channel Attention (ECA), a lightweight, phenology-aware object detection architecture derived from Ultralytics YOLOv5 for tomato growth stage recognition. A balanced dataset of 2,464 annotated images was constructed from locally collected greenhouse images in Bhutan and publicly available tomato images, with augmentation designed to simulate local greenhouse conditions. The dataset includes vegetative (820), flowering (824), fruiting (820), and background (26) samples. The proposed architecture introduces two customized backbone modules: C3 PhenoLite, which enhances spatial and texture feature extraction using depthwise residual refinement, and C3 ECA, which strengthens inter-channel feature interactions through efficient channel attention. The proposed model achieves 90.6% precision, 88.8% recall, and 92.6% mAP@50, with 4.0 million parameters and 10.9 GFLOPs at 640 x 640 resolution. These results demonstrate its potential for real-time and climate-resilient greenhouse deployment in Bhutan.
zh_title: 资源受限不丹温室环境下基于轻量级物候感知YOLOv5框架的番茄生长阶段检测
translation: 准确检测番茄生长阶段对于特定阶段的温室管理和精细农业至关重要。在不丹，温室种植受到海拔变化、巨大昼夜温差、漫射照明、自动化程度有限以及缺乏本地注释数据集的影响，限制了常规深度学习模型的适用性。本工作提出了 PhenoLite + 高效通道注意力 (ECA)，这是一种源自 Ultralytics YOLOv5 的轻量级、物候感知目标检测架构，用于番茄生长阶段识别。通过收集的不丹本地温室图像和公开的番茄图像，构建了一个包含 2,464 个注释图像的平衡数据集，并进行了旨在模拟当地温室条件的增强。该数据集包括营养生长（820）、开花（824）、结果（820）和背景（26）样本。所提出的架构引入了两个定制的主干模块：C3 PhenoLite，通过深度残差细化增强空间和纹理特征提取；C3 ECA，通过高效的通道注意力增强通道间特征交互。所提出的模型在 640 x 640 分辨率下实现了 90.6% 的准确率、88.8% 的召回率和 92.6% 的 mAP@50，具有 400 万个参数和 10.9 GFLOPs。这些结果证明了其在不丹进行实时和气候适应性温室部署的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种轻量级物候感知的YOLOv5番茄生长阶段检测模型，专为资源受限的不丹温室环境设计，在低计算成本下实现了高精度检测。
ai_comments: 该论文针对不丹温室环境的特殊挑战（如海拔、温差、光照等资源受限条件），创新性地设计了一种轻量且具备物候感知能力的YOLOv5架构。通过引入C3 PhenoLite和C3 ECA模块，在保持较低参数量和计算复杂度的同时，显著提升了番茄生长阶段检测的准确率，为资源受限地区的精准农业落地提供了优秀的解决方案。
motivation: 不丹的温室栽培受海拔、昼夜温差大、弥散光照明、自动化程度低以及缺乏本地标注数据集等因素影响，传统的深度学习模型难以适用。为此，需要开发一种适合资源受限环境的轻量级番茄生长阶段检测框架。
method: 提出了一种基于Ultralytics YOLOv5改进的轻量级物候感知目标检测架构（PhenoLite + ECA），包含两个自定义的主干模块：C3 PhenoLite（利用深度可分离残差细化增强空间和纹理特征提取）和C3 ECA（通过高效通道注意力强化通道间特征交互），并使用包含2,464张图像的平衡数据集进行训练与验证。
results: 该模型在640x640分辨率下取得了90.6%的精确度、88.8%的召回率和92.6%的mAP@50，参数量仅为400万，计算量为10.9 GFLOPs。
conclusion: 该研究成功开发了轻量级、物候感知的PhenoLite + ECA YOLOv5模型，在不丹温室环境下实现了高效、高精度的番茄生长阶段检测，具有很强的实用价值和推广潜力。

title: VERA: Authority-Preserving Edge Revocation for Federated AI-Agent Workflows
authors: Lifei Liu, Haoran Yu, Xiaochong Jiang
abstract: Modern agent frameworks compose planners, tool agents, remote services, and shared specialists into runtime delegation graphs, but their revocation APIs still resemble token or subtree invalidation. When one delegation is withdrawn, the runtime must know which agents lose authority while independently authorized agents keep working. We study this authority consistency problem and introduce VERA (Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents), a verifier-checkable revocation contract and API emitted by agent-runtime adapters as signed evidence. Under disjunctive authority, revoking edge e invalidates exactly T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e}), the agents whose every authorizing root path used e. Used as a contract, this target exposes two runtime failures: tree cascades over-revoke shared agents, while deployer-scoped cascades under-revoke cross-domain descendants. In a LangGraph framework-replt cells repeated 20 times yield 500compiled-framework traces and 2,000 valid signed delegation decisions; 13/25 cells contain runtime multi-parsharing and 8/25 contain cross-deployer shies 500/500 target proofs, preserves all320 alternate-parent shared-agent cases that tree cascade revokes, and rejects unauthorized signers and omission attacks. Baseline replay over 1,9that holder/node and tree-style targetscannot express this behavior. We further validate schema portability on A2A, AutoGen, and CrewAI artifacts: nine traces, including five executable Cregned delegation events that pass schema and signature checks.
zh_title: VERA：联邦AI智能体工作流的权限保持边撤销机制
translation: 现代智能体框架将规划器、工具智能体、远程服务和共享专家组合成运行时委托图，但它们的撤销API仍然类似于令牌或子树失效。当撤销一个委托时，运行时必须知道哪些智能体失去了权限，同时让独立授权的智能体继续工作。我们研究了这一权限一致性问题，并引入了VERA（Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents），这是一种由智能体运行时适配器作为签名证据发出的可验证撤销契约和API。在析取权限下，撤销边e精确失效了T_intent(e,G) = reach(G) \ reach(G \ {e})，即那些每条授权根路径都使用过e的智能体。作为契约使用时，该目标暴露了两个运行时失败：树级联过度撤销共享智能体，而部署者范围的级联则对跨域后代欠撤销。在一个LangGraph框架实验中，重复20次的replt单元产生了500个编译框架轨迹和2,000个有效的签名委托决策；13/25个单元包含运行时多方共享，8/25个单元包含跨部署者隔离，500/500的目标证明，保留了树级联所撤销的所有320个替代父节点共享智能体案例，并拒绝了未授权的签名者和遗漏攻击。在1,9...的基线重放表明持有者/节点和树式目标无法表达这种行为。我们进一步在A2A、AutoGen和CrewAI工件上验证了模式可移植性：九个轨迹，包括五个通过模式和签名检查的可执行Cregned委托事件。
tldr: 本文提出了VERA，一种用于联邦AI智能体工作流的精确权限撤销契约与API，解决了传统撤销机制导致的过度撤销和欠撤销问题。
ai_comments: 该论文针对现代联邦AI智能体工作流中权限撤销的痛点，提出了VERA这一可验证的边撤销合约与API。创新之处在于精确刻画了“析取权限”下的依赖关系，避免了传统树形撤销或部署者范围撤销带来的过度撤销或欠撤销问题，并通过多框架（LangGraph、A2A、AutoGen、CrewAI）验证了其有效性和便携性。
motivation: 现代AI智能体框架通过将规划器、工具智能体、远程服务等组合成运行时委托图，但现有的撤销API仍类似于令牌或子树失效机制。当撤销某个委托时，运行时必须明确哪些智能体失去权限，同时保持独立授权的智能体继续工作，现有方法无法精确表达这种权限一致性需求。
method: 引入VERA（Verifiable Edge Revocation for Agents），这是一种由智能体运行时适配器发出的、作为签名证据的可验证撤销合约与API。在析取权限下，通过精确计算受影响的目标节点集合来避免过度撤销与欠撤销，并在LangGraph、A2A、AutoGen和CrewAI等框架上验证了其模式可移植性和签名检查机制。
results: 在LangGraph框架的实验中，500个编译框架轨迹和2000个有效的签名委托决策表明，VERA成功生成了500/500个目标证明，保留了所有320个被树形级联错误撤销的替代父节点共享智能体案例，并拒绝了未授权的签名者和遗漏攻击。同时在A2A、AutoGen和CrewAI上验证了其模式可移植性。
conclusion: VERA通过引入可验证的边撤销机制与签名契约，解决了联邦AI智能体工作流中的权限一致性问题，既能准确撤销依赖边失效的智能体，又能保护独立授权智能体的正常工作，并在多种智能体框架中表现出良好的便携性和安全性。

title: A Hybrid State-Space Approach for Census-Tract Population Estimation
authors: Jackson R. Ye, Alexandre V. Morozov
abstract: Sequence models---the architecture family behind large language models and, increasingly, state-of-the-art image recognition---have redefined how machines learn from high-dimensional data. Yet population estimation from satellite imagery, a task that underpins infrastructure planning, public health, and disaster response, has scarcely benefited: leading systems still bind population to a uniform raster, disaggregating census counts onto grid cells through weighting surfaces built from ancillary data (e.g., in WorldPop and LandScan), which can introduce systematic spatial bias, and predicting population per grid cell with convolutional neural networks. In this approach, the administrative-unit structure in which the census was actually collected is discarded. We close this gap with MambaPop, which renders each administrative unit as a single polygon-masked satellite image and treats tract-level population estimation as a sequence-modeling problem over its image patches, pairing each tract image directly with its population label and eliminating the disaggregation step entirely. Built on the hybrid state-space--attention MambaVision backbone, MambaPop is, to our knowledge, the first method to learn population directly from an administrative unit's own image as well as the first to apply a state-space based (Mamba) hybrid architecture to the population estimation task. Across all $\sim$84{,}000 contiguous-US census tracts of the 2020 census, MambaPop attains a mean absolute error (MAE) of $1{,}141$ persons per tract, matching the strongest convolutional baseline (YOLOv11, MAE $1{,}122$).
zh_title: 一种用于人口普查地块人口估计的混合状态空间方法
translation: 序列模型——作为大语言模型背后的架构家族，以及越来越多地应用于最先进图像识别的技术——重新定义了机器从高维数据中学习的方式。然而，利用卫星图像进行人口估计（这一支撑基础设施规划、公共卫生和灾害响应的任务）却几乎没有受益：领先的系统仍然将人口绑定到统一的网格上，通过由辅助数据构建的加权表面将普查计数解聚到网格单元上（例如WorldPop和LandScan中的做法），这可能会引入系统的空间偏差，并且利用卷积神经网络来预测每个网格单元的人口。在这种方法中，实际收集普查数据的行政单元结构被丢弃了。我们通过MambaPop弥补了这一差距，它将每个行政单元渲染为单个多边形掩码卫星图像，并将地块级别的人口估计视为对其图像块的序列建模问题，将每个地块图像与其人口标签直接配对，完全消除了解聚步骤。基于混合状态空间-注意力机制的MambaVision骨干网络，据我们所知，MambaPop是第一种直接从行政单元自身的图像中学习人口的方法，也是第一种将基于状态空间（Mamba）的混合架构应用于人口估计任务的方法。在2020年美国本土的所有约84,000个普查地块中，MambaPop实现了每地块1,141人的平均绝对误差（MAE），与最强的卷积基线（YOLOv11，MAE为1,122人）相匹配。
tldr: 本文开发了首个基于状态空间模型（Mamba）的人口估计方法MambaPop，直接从卫星图像中的普查地块预测人口，消除了传统的网格解聚步骤，并达到了与最强卷积基线相当的精度。
ai_comments: 本文创新性地将状态空间模型（Mamba）和序列建模思想引入人口普查地块估计任务中，避免了传统基于网格解聚方法的系统性空间偏差，展示了现代序列模型在地理空间数据分析中的潜力。
motivation: 现有基于卫星图像的人口估计系统通常将人口绑定到统一网格上，通过辅助数据进行解聚（如WorldPop和LandScan），这会引入系统性空间偏差并丢弃了原始的行政单元结构。为了弥补这一差距，需要一种能够直接从行政单元图像学习人口的方法。
method: 提出了MambaPop方法，将每个行政单元渲染为单个多边形掩码的卫星图像，将其普查地块级别的人口估计视为图像块上的序列建模问题，基于混合状态空间-注意力机制的MambaVision骨干网络直接将地块图像与人口标签配对，消除了网格解聚步骤。
results: 在2020年美国本土约84,000个普查地块的测试中，MambaPop达到了每地块1,141人的平均绝对误差（MAE），与最强的卷积基线（YOLOv11，MAE为1,122人）表现相当。
conclusion: MambaPop方法通过直接对普查小区图像块进行序列建模预测人口，消除了传统的解聚步骤，在全美约84,000个普查地块上取得了与最强卷积基线相当的性能，验证了该方法的有效性。

title: Arkios: An Open Bilingual English-Nepali Language Model Trained From Scratch, with a Devanagari-Aware Tokenizer
authors: Sajal Regmi, Siddhartha Pudasaini, Chetan Phakami Pun
abstract: We present Arkios, a 1.04B-parameter dense transformer pretrained from scratch on 150B tokens of bilingual English-Nepali text, using a custom single-file C/CUDA training stack and a Devanagari-aware byte-level BPE tokenizer built for this project. On ARC-Easy and ARC-Challenge, Arkios exceeds three comparably sized open models (Pythia-1.4B, TinyLlama-1.1B, OLMo-1B) despite an order of magnitude fewer training tokens, likely aided by a match between our educational-web-text pretraining data and ARC's grade-school-science format rather than a general capability advantage. We report full evaluation results under standard protocols, including a correction to an earlier partial-sample estimate, and findings specific to evaluating small models in a low-resource language: the standard multiple-choice-letter prompt format used by common evaluation harnesses places this model at chance on Nepali reading comprehension, and simultaneously at chance on English in the same format, which would lead a naive benchmark run to conclude the model has no Nepali ability when in fact it does. Concretely, both languages score at chance in the letter-choice format (0.240 Nepali, 0.236 English, against a chance baseline of 0.250), while scoring the answer text directly reveals genuine, English-favoring comprehension (0.306 Nepali, 0.387 English). We describe a manifest-conditioned tool-use contract introduced during instruction tuning, where tool calls are permitted only when a tool manifest is declared in context and suppressed otherwise, and report where that contract holds and where it does not. We release both the base and instruction-tuned model weights under Apache-2.0. The training code and a small privately-sourced portion of the Nepali pretraining corpus are not released; everything needed to reproduce the reported numbers from the released weights is included here.
zh_title: Arkios：一个从头训练的开源双语英语-尼泊尔语语言模型，带有梵文感知分词器
translation: 我们推出了Arkios，这是一个10.4亿参数的稠密Transformer模型，使用1500亿双语英语-尼泊尔语文本从头预训练，采用了定制的单文件C/CUDA训练栈以及为此项目构建的梵文感知字节级BPE分词器。在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上，尽管训练Token数量少了一个数量级，Arkios的表现仍优于三个同等大小的开源模型（Pythia-1.4B、TinyLlama-1.1B、OLMo-1B），这可能是因为我们的教育网络文本预训练数据与ARC的小学科学格式相匹配，而不是由于通用的能力优势。我们报告了标准协议下的完整评估结果，包括对早期部分样本估计的修正，以及在低资源语言中评估小模型的特定发现：通用评估工具中使用的标准多项选择字母提示格式使该模型在尼泊尔语阅读理解上处于随机猜测水平，同时在相同格式的英语上也是随机水平，这会导致天真的基准测试运行得出该模型没有尼泊尔语能力的结论，而实际上并非如此。具体来说，这两种语言在字母选择格式下的得分都在随机水平（尼泊尔语0.240，英语0.236，随机基准为0.250），而直接对答案文本进行评分则显示出真实的、倾向于英语的理解能力（尼泊尔语0.306，英语0.387）。我们描述了在指令微调期间引入的清单条件工具使用契约，其中仅在上下文中声明工具清单时才允许进行工具调用，否则将其抑制，并报告了该契约生效和失效的地方。我们在Apache-2.0下发布了基础模型和指令微调模型的权重。训练代码和尼泊尔语预训练语料库的一小部分私有来源未发布；复制发布权重的报告数字所需的一切都包含在此处。
tldr: 本文介绍了Arkios——一个1.04B参数的双语英语-尼泊尔语开源大模型，分享了其在低资源语言分词、预训练及评估方法上的重要发现。
ai_comments: 本文介绍了Arkios模型的构建，特别是针对尼泊尔语这种低资源语言的分词优化和评估方法揭示了评估范式对结果的潜在影响。这对于多语言和低资源大语言模型的研究具有重要参考价值。
motivation: 为了解决低资源语言（如尼泊尔语）在大语言模型预训练、分词和评估中面临的挑战，并开发一个开源的双语英语-尼泊尔语基础模型。
method: 使用1500亿双语英语-尼泊尔语文本从头预训练了一个10.4亿参数的稠密Transformer模型，采用自定义的C/CUDA训练栈和专为梵文优化的字节级BPE分词器。
results: Arkios在ARC-Easy和ARC-Challenge上超越了多个同等大小的开源模型；研究发现标准的字母选择提示格式会导致低资源语言的阅读 comprehension 评估出现偏差，直接评分能展现真实的理解能力。
conclusion: Arkios证明了针对低资源语言进行特定分词和预训练的有效性，并强调了在评估低资源语言模型时采用正确提示词格式的重要性。

title: SMOTE-VAR: An Uncertainty-Aware Oversampling Method for Predicting Depression Remission in University Students
authors: Dang Nguyen, Arun Kumar A V, Taylor A. Braund, Wu Yi Zheng, Debopriyo Bal, Leonard Hoon, Jill Newby, Helen Christensen, Svetha Venkatesh, Alexis Whitton, Sunil Gupta
abstract: University students experience disproportionately high rates of common mental health conditions, such as depression, which can impair learning, social functioning, and overall well-being. Although lifestyle interventions such as mindfulness and physical activity can reduce the symptoms, many do not achieve symptomatic remission. Developing new approaches to identify students with poor outcomes could enable earlier and more targeted intervention. Machine learning (ML) methods have increasingly been used to predict remission in depressive patients. However, these ML models often suffer from class imbalance, where there may be an unequal proportion of people in the remitted group relative to the non-remitted group. This imbalance can reduce model accuracy and bias predictions. To address this, studies commonly employ the popular oversampling strategy SMOTE. However, SMOTE has a notable limitation: it may generate invalid synthetic minority samples. In a clinical context, these false positives can lead to incorrect risk stratification, potentially delaying necessary escalated care for patients unlikely to remit. In this paper, we introduce a novel and effective oversampling method that addresses this shortcoming. Our approach leverages the variance function of a Gaussian process to estimate the uncertainty of generated minority samples to reduce false positives. We validate our method on a depression dataset collected from university students and demonstrate that it is better than existing oversampling approaches in predicting remission (i.e., treatment outcome). By improving the reliable identification of non-responders, our method provides a robust computational tool to help clinicians rapidly pivot to adjunctive therapies, thereby personalizing and optimizing mental health care pathways.
zh_title: SMOTE-VAR：一种预测大学生抑郁缓解的不确定感知过采样方法
translation: 大学生成为常见心理健康状况（如抑郁症）的高发人群，这会损害学习、社会功能和整体健康。尽管正念和体育活动等生活方式干预可以减轻症状，但许多人并未实现症状缓解。开发预测预后不良学生的新方法可以实现更早、更有针对性的干预。机器学习（ML）方法越来越多地用于预测抑郁症患者的缓解情况。然而，这些机器学习模型经常遭受类不平衡的困扰，即缓解组与未缓解组的比例可能不相等。这种不平衡会降低模型准确性并使预测产生偏差。为了解决这个问题，研究通常采用流行的过采样策略SMOTE。然而，SMOTE有一个明显的局限性：它可能会生成无效的合成少数类样本。在临床背景下，这些假阳性可能导致不正确的风险分层，从而可能延迟对不太可能缓解的患者进行必要的升级护理。在本文中，我们介绍了一种新颖且有效的过采样方法，以解决这一缺点。我们的方法利用高斯过程的方差函数来估计生成的少数类样本的不确定性，以减少假阳性。我们在从大学生收集的抑郁数据集上验证了我们的方法，并证明它在预测缓解（即治疗结果）方面优于现有的过采样方法。通过提高对无反应者的可靠识别，我们的方法提供了一个强大的计算工具，可帮助临床医生迅速转向辅助疗法，从而个性化和优化心理健康护理路径。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SMOTE-VAR的新型过采样方法，利用高斯过程不确定性减少假阳性，从而更准确地预测大学生抑郁症治疗的缓解情况。
ai_comments: 该论文针对医疗预测中的类不平衡问题，创新性地结合了高斯过程的不确定性估计，有效减少了合成样本中的假阳性，提升了临床决策支持的可靠性。
motivation: 大学生群体中抑郁症高发，尽管有生活方式干预，但许多人未能实现缓解。机器学习用于预测缓解时常面临类不平衡问题，而传统的SMOTE方法会生成无效的合成少数类样本（假阳性），导致不正确的风险分层和延误护理。
method: 提出了一种名为SMOTE-VAR的新型过采样方法，利用高斯过程的方差函数来估计生成的少数类样本的不确定性，从而减少假阳性。
results: 在大学生抑郁数据集上的验证表明，该方法在预测抑郁症治疗缓解方面优于现有的过采样方法。
conclusion: SMOTE-VAR方法通过引入不确定性感知的过采样，有效解决了机器学习模型在预测大学生抑郁症缓解时的类不平衡与假阳性问题，为个性化心理健康护理提供了稳健的计算工具。

title: A Simple Transformer Pipeline for Full-Key Side-Channel Attacks on Uncropped Datasets
authors: Jimmy Gammell, Kaushik Roy
abstract: Deep learning-based side-channel analysis has historically focused on single-byte targets and manually cropped traces, which risks discarding exploitable leakage. While recent work has proposed specialized architectures and resampling techniques to address this gap, the literature lacks a simple transformer baseline for simultaneous full-key attacks on uncropped traces. We present an open-source transformer implementation for uncropped full-key attacks which uses the standard transformer encoder backbone, adapting only the input and output layers to the side-channel setting. We release our implementation, training recipes, and pretrained weights for uncropped ASCADv1f, ASCADv1r, and CHES-CTF-2018 which achieve performance competitive with previously-reported results, while using less than 10GB of VRAM and requiring at most 3.34 hours of training on a single NVIDIA A6000.
comment: Accepted to the OPTIMIST Workshop '26 at CHES 2026. 6 pages, 1 figure. Code can be found at https://github.com/jimgammell/simple-transformer-pipeline-for-sca

title: Graph4BiLO: Graph Neural Network Approximation for Bilevel Mixed-Integer Linear Optimization
authors: Jessica D. Elrefaei, Kaixun Hua, Seungbae Kim, Hoang Nam Tran, Juan S. Borrero
abstract: Bilevel mixed-integer linear optimization problems model hierarchical decision processes in which a leader anticipates the optimal response of a follower. Although expressive, these problems are computationally challenging because lower-level optimality is embedded in the leader's feasible region. Value-function reformulations replace the nested follower optimization with a constraint involving the follower's optimal value, but evaluating this value function exactly can itself be expensive. This paper introduces Graph4BiLO, a graph neural network (GNN) approach for learning bilevel value functions from variable--constraint graph representations. In contrast to fixed-length multilayer perceptron (MLP) representations, the GNN uses shared message-passing parameters and can therefore be applied across multiple problem sizes with a single trained model. The learned ReLU network is encoded exactly as mixed-integer linear constraints and embedded in an approximate single-level formulation. A repair step subsequently re-solves the follower problem for the selected leader decision to recover a bilevel-feasible follower response. We evaluate Graph4BiLO on knapsack interdiction instances with 20--100 items against the exact MibS solver and the learning-based Neur2BiLO method. Graph4BiLO obtains objective values comparable to Neur2BiLO across all tested sizes while avoiding size-specific neural networks. An additional out-of-distribution experiment demonstrates zero-shot transfer from 20-item training instances to previously unseen 40- and 60-item instances. However, embedding message passing at every graph node substantially increases the resulting mixed-integer formulation size and solve time. These results identify a central tradeoff between size-generalizable graph representations and the computational cost of embedding GNNs within optimization models.

zh_title: Graph4BiLO：用于双层混合整数线性规划的图神经网络近似方法
translation: 双层混合整数线性规划问题对领导者预测跟随者最优响应的分层决策过程进行了建模。尽管表达能力强，但由于下层最优性嵌入在领导者的可行域中，这些问题在计算上具有挑战性。价值函数重构用涉及跟随者最优值的约束替换了嵌套的跟随者优化，但精确评估该价值函数本身可能是昂贵的。本文介绍了Graph4BiLO，这是一种从变量-约束图表示中学习双层价值函数的图神经网络（GNN）方法。与固定长度的多层感知机（MLP）表示相比，GNN使用共享的消息传递参数，因此可以通过单个训练模型应用于多个问题规模。学到的ReLU网络被精确编码为混合整数线性约束，并嵌入到近似的单层公式中。修复步骤随后为选定的领导者决策重新求解跟随者问题，以恢复双层可行的跟随者响应。我们在包含20-100个物品的背包拦截实例上评估了Graph4BiLO，并与精确的MibS求解器以及基于学习的Neur2BiLO方法进行了对比。Graph4BiLO在所有测试规模上都获得了与Neur2BiLO相当的目标值，同时避免了特定规模的神经网络。额外的分布外实验展示了从20个物品的训练实例到以前未见的40个和60个物品实例的零样本迁移。然而，在每个图节点嵌入消息传递大大增加了生成的混合整数公式规模和求解时间。这些结果指出了尺寸可泛化的图表示与在优化模型中嵌入GNN的计算成本之间的核心权衡。
tldr: 本文提出Graph4BiLO，一种利用图神经网络近似双层价值函数的方法，实现了跨问题规模的泛化，但同时也带来了更大的求解计算开销。
ai_comments: 该论文将图神经网络（GNN）引入双层混合整数线性规划中，创新性地使用GNN替代传统的MLP，克服了模型对问题规模的限制，实现了零样本迁移。但由于在每个图节点嵌入消息传递导致MILP模型规模和求解时间增加，揭示了尺寸泛化能力与优化模型计算成本之间的权衡。
motivation: 传统的双层混合整数线性规划计算挑战大，而现有的基于多层感知机（MLP）的学习方法受限于固定长度的表示，无法直接应用于不同规模的问题。
method: 提出Graph4BiLO方法，使用图神经网络（GNN）从变量-约束图表示中学习双层价值函数，将学习到的ReLU网络精确编码为混合整数线性约束并嵌入单-level公式中，最后通过修复步骤恢复双层可行的跟随者响应。
results: 在背包拦截实例上的评估表明，Graph4BiLO在所有测试规模上均获得了与Neur2BiLO相当的目标值，且无需针对特定规模训练神经网络，同时展示了良好的零-shot泛化能力（从20项到40、60项）。不过，图消息传递嵌入也导致了MILP公式规模和求解时间的增加。
conclusion: Graph4BiLO通过图神经网络近似双层价值函数，能够跨不同问题规模应用并支持零样本迁移，但GNN的嵌入也带来了显著的计算复杂度。

title: FocusAdapt: Context-aware Adaptive Focus Assistance in Diminished Reality
authors: Tianyu Zhang, Shutong Wu, Jiankun Yang, Zhen Bai, Yukang Yan
abstract: Diminished Reality (DR) can reduce visual clutter by removing irrelevant objects. However, removing all task-irrelevant objects may eliminate useful contextual information and reduce situational awareness. We present FocusAdapt, a context-aware DR system that predicts object-level distraction by integrating visual saliency, semantic relevance, and gaze behavior. Based on findings from a formative study, FocusAdapt selectively diminishes highly distracting objects while preserving useful context, enabling adaptive focus assistance during procedural tasks.
zh_title: FocusAdapt：减弱现实中情境感知的自适应焦点辅助
translation: 减弱现实（DR）可以通过移除无关物体来减少视觉杂乱。然而，移除所有与任务无关的物体可能会消除有用的上下文信息并降低情境感知能力。我们提出了 FocusAdapt，这是一个上下文感知的 DR 系统，它通过整合视觉显著性、语义相关性和注视行为来预测对象级别的干扰。基于形成性研究的发现，FocusAdapt 选择性地减弱高度分散注意力的物体，同时保留有用的上下文，从而在程序性任务中实现自适应的焦点辅助。
tldr: FocusAdapt 是一个上下文感知的减弱现实系统，通过预测对象干扰来选择性地减弱杂物，同时保留关键的上下文信息。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的减弱现实（DR）系统 FocusAdapt，通过整合视觉显著性、语义相关性和注视行为来预测对象级干扰，从而在消除干扰的同时保留重要的上下文信息。这对于提高复杂任务中的情境感知能力具有重要意义。
motivation: 传统的减弱现实技术通过移除所有与任务无关的物体来减少视觉杂乱，但这会消除有用的上下文信息并降低情境感知能力。
method: 提出 FocusAdapt 系统，结合视觉显著性、语义相关性和注视行为预测对象级干扰，并根据形成性研究的结果进行选择性减弱。
results: FocusAdapt 能够选择性地减弱高度分散注意力的物体，同时保留有用的上下文，从而在执行程序性任务时实现自适应的焦点辅助。
conclusion: FocusAdapt 有效地平衡了视觉减 clutter 与情境保持，为程序性任务提供了一种自适应的焦点辅助方案。

title: Fluid Antenna Multiple Access for Noise Modulation
authors: Hadi Zayyani, Felipe A. P. de Figueiredo
abstract: Noise modulation (NoiseMod) encodes information in the variance of a noise-like waveform. Its noncoherent structure enables low-complexity links, but co-channel users are challenging because interference affects the same variance statistic used for detection. We study fluid antenna multiple access (FAMA) for two-level NoiseMod with independent random bits from each interferer, producing two possible nonzero interference variances. We adopt exact finite-sample maximum-likelihood energy detection from prior NoiseMod/TNM work. We derive the exact single-port moment-generating function and moments of the random-bit aggregate interference, including heterogeneous user powers, and prove that the port minimizing conditional BEP is $\arg\max_k H_k/(σ_w^2+J_k)$, where $H_k$ is desired-link power and $J_k$ is instantaneous bit-state-aware interference variance. For independent fading ports, the common interferer-bit vector couples per-port decision metrics; conditioning on the number of high-state interferers yields an exact binomial-mixture order-statistic representation and avoids the generally invalid rule $F_{Z_{\max}}=F_Z^{N_p}$. For spatially correlated operation, an integer-$μ$ $κ$-$μ$ benchmark uses full pairwise Jakes correlation in scattered fields, with channel-averaged BEP evaluated by conditional Monte Carlo. A standard-error-aware load study shows increased admissible co-channel users as spatial degrees of freedom grow. Finally, a finite-sample variance-domain sensing diagnostic quantifies the oracle gap under frozen channels and interferer states, providing a lower-bound warning on fast-FAMA sensing difficulty rather than a deployable acquisition protocol.
zh_title: 用于噪声调制Fluid Antenna多址接入技术
translation: 噪声调制（NoiseMod）通过噪声样波形的方差来编码信息。其非相干结构实现了低复杂度链路，但同频用户构成了挑战，因为干扰会影响用于检测的同一方差统计量。我们研究了用于两级NoiseMod的流体天线多址接入（FAMA），其中每个干扰源具有独立的随机比特，产生两个可能的非零干扰方差。我们采用了先前NoiseMod/TNM工作中的精确有限样本最大似然能量检测。我们推导了精确的单端口矩生成函数以及随机比特聚合干扰的矩（包括异构用户功率），并证明了使条件BEP最小化的端口是 $\arg\max_k H_k/(σ_w^2+J_k)$，其中 $H_k$ 是期望链路功率，$J_k$ 是瞬时比特状态感知的干扰方差。对于独立衰落端口，公共干扰比特向量耦合了各端口的决策度量；以高状态干扰源数量为条件，得出了精确的二项混合次序统计量表示，避免了通常无效的规则 $F_{Z_{\max}}=F_Z^{N_p}$。对于空间相关操作，整数-$\mu$ $\kappa$-$\mu$基准在散射场中使用全成对Jakes相关性，并通过条件蒙特卡洛评估信道平均BEP。标准差感知的负载研究表明，随着空间自由度的增长，可容纳的同频用户增加。最后，有限样本方差域传感诊断量化了信道和干扰状态冻结下的oracle间隙，为快速FAMA传感难度提供了下限预警，而非可部署的捕获协议。
tldr: 本文研究了结合噪声调制与流体天线多址接入（FAMA）的系统，通过严密的数学分析证明了FAMA能够有效缓解噪声调制中的同频干扰并提升系统容量。
ai_comments: 本文将流体天线多址接入（FAMA）与噪声调制（NoiseMod）技术相结合，通过严密的数学推导和精确的有限样本分析，展示了FAMA在提高多用户系统容量和应对同频干扰方面的巨大潜力，为低复杂度、高密度的无线通信提供了新的理论支撑。
motivation: 噪声调制（NoiseMod）虽然通过非相干结构实现了低复杂度链路，但同频用户带来的干扰会直接影响用于检测的方差统计量，这给多用户接入带来了巨大挑战。因此，需要研究流体天线多址接入（FAMA）技术来克服这一难题。
method: 采用精确的有限样本最大似然能量检测，推导了单端口矩生成函数、随机比特聚合干扰的矩，证明了最小化条件比特误码率（BEP）的端口选择准则；对于独立衰落端口，通过对高状态干扰源数量进行条件划分得到二项混合次序统计量表示；对于空间相关操作，利用整数-$\mu$ $\kappa$-$\mu$基准和条件蒙特卡洛评估信道平均BEP。
results: 推导出了精确的单端口矩生成函数和干扰矩；证明了最优端口选择准则；空间相关性分析和负载研究表明，随着空间自由度的增加，系统可容纳的同频用户数量增加；有限样本方差域传感诊断量化了信道和干扰状态冻结下的oracle间隙。
conclusion: 研究证明了流体天线多址接入能够有效支持噪声调制系统中的多用户同频共存，随着空间自由度的增加，可容纳的同频用户显著增多。

title: AtlasNLP: A Country-Aware Atlas of Dataset Representation in NLP
authors: Joan Nwatu, Tsedeniya Solomon Amare, Longju Bai, Bontu Fufa Balcha, Zayd Bashir, Angana Borah, Zara Burzo, Yubin Choi, Naihao Deng, Samika Gupta, Michel Faloughi, Claude Kwizera, Ziqiao Ma, Cynthia Yacel Fuertes Panizo, Ellie Seehorn, Hui Shen, Jiayi Tang, Zesen Zhao, Boyuan Zheng, Rada Mihalcea
abstract: Understanding which countries are represented in NLP datasets is essential for identifying gaps, targeting data collection, measuring progress, and informing AI policy. However, geographic metadata is very rarely available, and country-level representation is often hidden behind broad language-level claims. We introduce AtlasNLP, a country-aware atlas of over 13,000 NLP dataset records across normalized NLP task categories, tracking both the populations represented and where datasets are produced. AtlasNLP includes AtlasNLP-Gold, a human-curated reference set, and AtlasNLP-Core, an ACL-derived large-scale collection. Using this resource, we show that (1) dataset coverage is highly uneven across countries and tasks; (2) dataset production and representation are geographically asymmetric; and (3) language coverage does not imply geographic representation. These findings reveal blind spots in current dataset documentation practices and motivate more explicit geographic metadata for country-aware NLP evaluation.
comment: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
zh_title: AtlasNLP：一个具有国家感知能力的NLP数据集代表性图谱
translation: 了解哪些国家在NLP数据集中得到代表对于识别差距、指导数据收集、衡量进展以及为AI政策提供信息至关重要。然而，地理元数据极其罕见，国家层面的代表性往往隐藏在宽泛的语言级声明之后。我们介绍了AtlasNLP，这是一个涵盖超过13,000条标准化NLP任务类别记录的国家感知图谱，用于追踪代表性人口和数据集产地。AtlasNLP包括人工策划的参考集AtlasNLP-Gold和衍生自ACL的大规模集合AtlasNLP-Core。利用这一资源，我们表明：（1）数据集覆盖在不同国家和任务之间高度不均；（2）数据集的生产和代表性在地理上是不对称的；（3）语言覆盖并不意味着地理代表性。这些发现揭示了当前数据集文档实践中的盲点，并促使在国家感知的NLP评估中需要更明确的地理元数据。
tldr: 本文推出了AtlasNLP图谱，填补了NLP数据集地理元数据的空白，并揭示了全球数据代表性严重不均及语言与地理代表性脱节的问题。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了AtlasNLP，填补了NLP数据集中地理元数据匮乏的空白，揭示了当前数据集中存在的严重地理不平等与语言-地理脱节现象，对未来AI政策制定和数据集收集具有重要指导意义。
motivation: 为了识别NLP数据集中的地域代表性空白、指导数据收集、衡量进展并为AI政策提供参考，然而目前NLP领域极少提供地理元数据，且常被宽泛的语言级声明所掩盖。
method: 通过构建AtlasNLP（包含人工策划的AtlasNLP-Gold和ACL衍生的AtlasNLP-Core，涵盖超过13,000条NLP数据集记录），在规范化的NLP任务类别下追踪代表性人口与数据集产地，并进行分析。
results: 研究发现：（1）数据集覆盖范围在不同国家和任务间极不均衡；（2）数据集的生产与人口代表性存在地理上的不对称性；（3）语言覆盖并不能等同于地理代表性。
conclusion: AtlasNLP揭示了NLP数据集在国家和任务层面的严重分布不均以及语言与地理代表性的脱节，强调了在未来NLP研究中明确标注地理元数据的必要性。

title: COGTRL: Training LLMs for Scientific Discovery Assistance using Cognitive Traces via Reinforcement Learning
authors: Shrinidhi Kumbhar Santosh Mashetty Divij Handa Kevin Coutinho, Siddharth Sambhaji Ghule, Chitta Baral
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) trained on extensive scientific research are increasingly integrated as assistants for scientific discovery. However, most research papers omit the fine-grained cognitive process of examining constraints, failed alternatives, and iterative decisions required to achieve the desired goal. Such cognitive processes are vital for real-world scientists working toward specific goals under constraints. In this paper, we show that LLMs, when trained to produce such cognitive traces, perform better as scientific discovery assistants than when trained solely on scientific literature. We propose COGTRL, a trajectory-level reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to emulate cognitively grounded reasoning by jointly optimizing cognitive traces and the scientific steps produced in an interleaved manner. Across two 3B-parameter models and two scientific domains (AI and Materials Science), COGTRL improves method quality by an average of 7.85 points over comparable 3B model baselines and achieves competitive performance relative to 70B parameter models. Moreover, analysis by domain experts shows a preference for methods generated by COGTRL over the baselines.
zh_title: COGTRL：通过强化学习利用认知轨迹训练用于科学发现辅助的大语言模型
translation: 在广泛科学研究基础上训练的大语言模型（LLM）正日益被整合为科学发现的助手。然而，大多数研究论文省略了实现期望目标所需的、对约束条件、失败备选方案以及迭代决策进行审视的细粒度认知过程。这种认知过程对于在约束条件下朝着特定目标努力的现实世界科学家至关重要。在本文中，我们证明了当LLM被训练以产生此类认知轨迹时，它们作为科学发现助手的表现要优于仅在科学文献上训练时。我们提出了COGTRL，这是一个轨迹级强化学习框架，它通过以交替方式联合优化认知轨迹和产生的科学步骤，来训练LLM模拟以认知为基础的推理。在两个3B参数模型和两个科学领域（人工智能和材料科学）中，COGTRL的方法质量比同类3B模型基线平均提高了7.85分，并取得了相对于70B参数模型的竞争性性能。此外，领域专家的分析表明，与基线相比，他们更青睐由COGTRL生成的方法。
tldr: COGTRL框架通过强化学习训练LLMs生成科学发现中的“认知轨迹”，使3B小模型在科研辅助任务上超越同类基线并比肩70B大模型。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了认知轨迹（Cognitive Traces）来模仿科学家真实的科研决策过程，并通过轨迹级强化学习（COGTRL）框架在交替优化中提升大模型作为科研助手的性能。该方法在3B参数规模的模型上取得了越级挑战70B大模型的出色效果，展示了过程监督在科学发现中的巨大潜力。
motivation: 大多数科学论文省略了实现目标所需的细粒度认知过程（如考察约束、失败的备选方案和迭代决策），而这些认知过程对于在约束条件下工作的现实科学家至关重要。传统的仅基于科学文献训练的LLM缺乏这种认知基础。
method: 提出了COGTRL（基于认知轨迹的强化学习）框架，通过轨迹级强化学习，以交替优化的方式联合训练大模型生成认知轨迹与科学步骤。
results: 在两个3B参数模型和两个科学领域（人工智能和材料科学）的实验中，COGTRL相比同类3B模型基线平均方法质量提升了7.85分，并取得了与70B参数模型相媲美的竞争性能，且领域专家更偏爱COGTRL生成的方法。
conclusion: 通过COGTRL框架训练LLMs生成认知轨迹，能够显著提升模型在AI和材料科学领域的科学发现辅助能力，实现小模型对大模型的性能超越。

title: Learning Proportional Committees from Violation Feedback
authors: Frank Connor
abstract:
We study violation-feedback learning of proportionally representative approval-based committees. In each round, a learner proposes a committee of size $k$. An oracle either accepts the proposal or adversarially selects a representation violation with respect to a single fixed hidden approval profile. We compare \emph{full-witness feedback}, which reveals the violation level, an omitted candidate, and the affected voter group, with \emph{candidate-only feedback}, which reveals only that candidate. The target notions are proportional justified representation plus (PJR+) and extended justified representation plus (EJR+).
  In every setting we study, the number of rejected proposals can be bounded solely in terms of $k$, with no dependence on the numbers of voters and candidates. For PJR+, the optimal deterministic and randomized rejection complexities equal $k$ under both feedback models. For EJR+, the picture is more nuanced. Under full-witness feedback, we prove an $Ω(k^{3/2})$ deterministic lower bound and give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm using $O(k^2\log k)$ rejections. Under candidate-only feedback, randomization achieves $O(k^2\log k)$ expected rejections via uniform random deletion, while deterministic exhaustive branching gives a $2^{O(k^2(\log k)^2)}$ rejection bound. Even with full-witness feedback, randomized learners may require $k$ rejections.
zh_title: 从违背反馈中学习比例委员会
translation:
我们研究了基于违背反馈的比例代表制投票委员会的学习问题。在每一轮中，学习者提议一个大小为$k$的委员会。预言机（oracle）要么接受该提议，要么针对一个单一固定的隐藏审批档案，对抗性地选择一个代表性违背。我们将“完整见证反馈”（揭示违背水平、被遗漏的候选人和受影响的选民组）与“仅候选人反馈”（仅揭示该候选人）进行对比。目标概念是比例正当代表加（PJR+）和扩展正当代表加（EJR+）。
在我们研究的每个设置中，被拒绝提议的数量可以完全用$k$来界定，而与选民和候选人的数量无关。对于PJR+，在两种反馈模型下，最优的确定性和随机化拒绝复杂性都等于$k$. 对于EJR+，情况更为微妙。在完整见证反馈下，我们证明了 $\Omega(k^{3/2})$ 的确定性下界，并给出了一个使用 $O(k^2\log k)$ 次拒绝的确定性多项式时间算法。在仅候选人反馈下，随机化通过均匀随机删除实现了 $O(k^2\log k)$ 的期望拒绝次数，而确定性穷举分支给出了 $2^{O(k^2(\log k)^2)}$ 的拒绝界。即使有完整见证反馈，随机化学习者也可能需要 $k$ 次拒绝。
tldr: 本文研究了仅通过违背反馈高效学习满足比例代表性要求的委员会，证明了所需拒绝次数仅与委员会大小有关，而与选民和候选人规模无关。
ai_comments: 该论文研究了基于违背反馈的学习比例代表制委员会选择问题，创新性地将主动学习与社会选择理论结合，并针对不同的反馈类型（完整反馈与仅候选人反馈）以及不同的公理（PJR+和EJR+）给出了严格的复杂性上下界。
motivation: 探索如何在没有直接访问完整偏好档案的情况下，仅通过重复提议和对手提供的违背反馈，高效学习满足比例代表性（如PJR+和EJR+）的委员会。
method: 通过设计确定性和随机化算法，研究在完整见证反馈和仅候选人反馈下，针对PJR+和EJR+目标的拒绝复杂性上下界。
results: 对于PJR+，确定性和随机化拒绝复杂性在两种反馈下均为$k$；对于EJR+，在完整反馈下给出了$O(k^2\log k)$的确定性多项式时间算法，在仅候选人反馈下通过随机化实现了$O(k^2\log k)$的期望拒绝次数。
conclusion: 论文成功证明了在违背反馈下学习比例代表制委员会是高效的，拒绝次数可以仅由委员会大小$k$控制，与选民和候选人数量无关。

title: Can LLMs Take the Pulse of the Economy? A Real-Time Evaluation of LLM Nowcasts on Macroeconomic Indicators
authors: Xinyue Zhao, Ruiyi Zhang, Liqin Ye, Rui Cao, Pengtao Xie, Sudheer Chava
abstract: Nowcasting headline macroeconomic indicators, i.e., estimating an indicator's value for the current reference period before its official release, is critical for monetary policy and financial markets, and central banks devote dedicated teams of expert economists to producing such estimates. Large language model (LLM) agents are a promising candidate for this task, combining broad world knowledge with real-time web search and supporting queries at higher frequency than institutional nowcasts. Evaluating their nowcasting capability is, however, challenging: headline indicators such as GDP and CPI are widely reported and likely memorized during pretraining, so any evaluation on historical releases is vulnerable to data contamination. To address this, we introduce LiveMacroEval, a live, contamination-resistant benchmark in which LLM agents produce hourly nowcasts for sixteen major U.S. macroeconomic indicators over a pre-release window closing at each official release. Nowcast quality is assessed through a LiveMacro Score against announcement-window equity returns and a LiveBetting Score from simulated Polymarket-style trading, with Federal Reserve regional-bank nowcasts, the Bloomberg ECOS professional consensus, and an auto-ARIMA baseline as comparators. Over six months with four state-of-the-art LLM agents configured with web search, aggregate nowcast accuracy is broadly comparable to the institutional and professional benchmarks, with performance varying widely across individual indicators. This highlights LLM agents' potential as real-time estimators of macroeconomic conditions.
zh_title: 大模型能感知经济脉搏吗？对宏观经济指标大模型实时预测的评估
translation: 即时预测宏观经济关键指标（即在官方发布前估计当前参考期指标的值）对货币政策和金融市场至关重要，中央银行为此投入了专门的专业经济学家团队。大语言模型（LLM）智能体是该任务的有力候选，它将广泛的世界知识与实时网页搜索相结合，并支持比机构预测更高频率的查询。然而，评估其即时预测能力具有挑战性：诸如GDP和CPI等关键指标被广泛报道，很可能在预训练期间已被模型记住，因此对历史发布的任何评估都容易受到数据污染的影响。为了解决这个问题，我们推出了LiveMacroEval，这是一个实时的、抗数据污染的基准，其中LLM智能体在每次官方发布前的窗口期内，为十六个主要的美国宏观经济指标产生每小时的即时预测。即时预测质量通过针对公告窗口期股票回报的LiveMacro Score以及来自模拟Polymarket风格交易的LiveBetting Score进行评估，并以美联储地区银行的即时预测、彭博社ECOS专业共识以及auto-ARIMA基准作为对照。在配置了网页搜索的四个最先进LLM智能体为期六个月的测试中，聚合即时预测准确度与机构和专业基准大致相当，不过不同指标之间的性能差异很大。这突显了LLM智能体作为宏观经济状况实时估计器的潜力。
tldr: 该研究通过引入抗数据污染的实时基准LiveMacroEval，证明了大语言模型在宏观经济实时预测（Nowcasting）中的表现与专业机构基准相当。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了抗数据污染的实时基准LiveMacroEval，用于评估大语言模型在宏观经济实时预测（Nowcasting）中的表现。研究方法严谨，结合了市场收益和模拟交易评分，为评估LLM在金融和经济领域的实际应用能力提供了重要参考。
motivation: 宏观经济指标的实时预测（Nowcasting）对货币政策和金融市场至关重要。虽然LLM智能体结合网络搜索是该任务的潜在候选，但由于历史发布数据可能在预训练阶段被大模型记忆，评估其预测能力面临数据污染的挑战，因此需要一个抗污染的实时评估基准。
method: 引入了LiveMacroEval（一个抗数据污染的实时基准），配置了网络搜索功能的四个先进LLM智能体，在发布前的窗口期内每小时对16个美国主要宏观经济指标进行预测，并通过LiveMacro Score和LiveBetting Score与美联储区域银行预测、彭博社专业共识及自动ARIMA基准进行比较。
results: 在为期六个月、包含四个最先进LLM智能体的评估中，LLM的聚合预测准确率与机构和专业基准大致相当，但不同指标之间的预测表现差异很大。
conclusion: 大语言模型智能体具备成为实时宏观经济状况估计器的潜力，其聚合预测准确率与机构和专业基准大致相当，但不同指标间的表现存在显著差异。

title: Drishti: AI-Led Human-Directed Vulnerability Auditing for 5G Cores
authors: Sriram Ramachandran, Levente Csikor, Dinil Mon Divakaran
abstract: Candidate generation for open-source vulnerabilities is no longer scarce. AI-assisted code review now produces defect candidates cheaply, and industry programs pair them with expert human triage. The remaining scarcity is validation and impact assessment, and the gap is largest in critical-infrastructure software like 5G cores. Here, validation has four costs: verification, reachability, impact, and fix-completeness. We present Drishti, an AI-led human-directed vulnerability audit framework with four components, one per cost: (i) an anti-pattern catalog for verification, (ii) critical-path triage for reachability, (iii) concentric validation for impact, and (iv) patch-review for fix-completeness. Across audits of Open5GS and free5GC, Drishti produced three findings. The first is a pre-authentication NULL-dereference in the Open5GS NRF multipart parser, fixed upstream with a CVE requested. The second is an ASN.1-PER memory amplification in the free5GC NGAP decoder. A 2-byte input from a rogue gNodeB OOM-kills the AMF in 6.2 seconds. The third is a defective patch on CVE-2025-69248 whose defense-in-depth check is dead code before authentication.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, accepted for publication at ACM CCS workshop on CPSIoTSec 2026
zh_title: Drishti：面向5G核心网的AI主导、人类指导的漏洞审计
translation: 开源漏洞的候选生成已不再稀缺。AI辅助的代码审查现在可以低成本地产出缺陷候选，行业项目也将其与专家人工分类相结合。剩下的稀缺资源是验证和影响评估，而这一缺口在5G核心网等关键基础设施软件中最大。在这里，验证有四个成本：验证成本、可达性成本、影响成本和修复完整性成本。我们提出了Drishti，一个由AI主导、人类指导的漏洞审计框架，包含四个组件，每个成本对应一个：(i) 用于验证的反模式目录，(ii) 用于可达性的关键路径分类，(iii) 用于影响的同心验证，以及 (iv) 用于修复完整性的补丁审查。在对Open5GS和free5GC的审计中，Drishti产生了三个发现。首先是Open5GS NRF多部分解析器中的一个预认证NULL解引用漏洞，该漏洞已在上游修复并申请了CVE。其次是free5GC NGAP解码器中的ASN.1-PER内存放大漏洞，来自恶意gNodeB的2字节输入可在6.2秒内导致AMF被OOM杀掉。第三是CVE-2025-69248的一个失效补丁，其纵深防御检查在认证前属于死代码。
tldr: 本文提出了Drishti框架，通过AI主导与人工指导相结合的方式解决了5G核心网漏洞验证的难题，并在开源5G核心网中发现了高危漏洞。
ai_comments: Drishti创新性地提出了一种由AI主导、人类指导的漏洞审计框架，专门针对关键基础设施软件5G核心网面临的验证与影响评估难题。通过四个组件分别对应验证、可达性、影响和修复完整性四个成本，并在Open5GS和free5GC中成功发现了真实漏洞，具有极高的实际应用价值和安全性意义。
motivation: 尽管AI辅助的代码审查可以廉价地生成缺陷候选，但在关键基础设施软件（如5G核心网）中，漏洞验证和影响评估仍然存在巨大的稀缺性和成本。
method: 提出了Drishti框架，包含四个组件：用于验证的反模式目录、用于可达性的关键路径分类、用于影响的同心验证以及用于修复完整性的补丁审查。
results: 在Open5GS和free5GC的审计中，Drishti发现了三个重要成果：Open5GS NRF中的预认证NULL解引用漏洞（已请求CVE）、free5GC NGAP解码器中的ASN.1-PER内存放大漏洞（导致AMF在6.2秒内OOM），以及CVE-2025-69248的一个无效补丁。
conclusion: Drishti框架通过结合AI与人类专家的优势，有效解决了5G核心网等关键基础设施中漏洞验证和影响评估的难题，并在实际审计中发现了高危漏洞和缺陷补丁。

title: Supraglacial Lake Fate Is Knowable Long Before the Season Ends
authors: Emam Hossain, Md Osman Gani
abstract: A supraglacial lake on the Greenland Ice Sheet ends its melt season in one of four ways: it drains rapidly through a hydrofracture, drains slowly across the surface, refreezes in place, or is buried by late-season snowfall. Which one occurs decides whether the meltwater reaches the ice bed. Satellite classifiers recover the outcome accurately but only after the season closes, and how much of a season each outcome actually requires has never been measured. We measure it directly: holding the representation and the classifier fixed, we truncate the input at $14$ cutoffs from 1 May to 31 December, retrain at each, and record the earliest cutoff at which each outcome's per-class $F_1$ reaches a fixed target. The outcomes resolve in a consistent order, two of them months early: rapid drainage by 15 July and slow drainage by 1 August, $92$ and $75$ days ahead of the earliest date a full-season pipeline can be computed at all, with buried and refreeze following at $44$ and $30$ days. Five further learners, from a majority-class floor and $54$ summary statistics to a trigger-based early classifier, leave the ordering intact: every learner that produces a per-class trajectory reproduces it despite end-of-season accuracies differing by up to $18$ percentage points, and it survives leave-one-basin-out evaluation, though not the substitution of machine labels for expert ones in an unseen season. Every feature we compute at day $t$ reads only days up to $t$, at a cost of at most $1.3$ percentage points. A monitoring system should therefore not have one release date: rapid drainage can be flagged on 15 July, three months before a full-season pipeline can be computed at all.
zh_title: 冰面湖泊的命运在融冰季结束前很久即可知晓
translation: 格陵兰冰盖上的冰面湖泊以四种方式之一结束其融冰季：通过水力压裂快速排干、通过地表缓慢排干、原地冻结或被季末降雪掩埋。哪种情况发生决定了融水是否到达冰床。卫星分类器能准确恢复结果，但只能在季节结束后进行，且每种结果实际需要的季节时长从未被测量过。我们直接对其进行测量：固定表征和分类器，将输入在5月1日至12月31日的14个截断点截断，在每个截断点重新训练，并记录每个结果的各类别$F_1$达到固定目标的最早截断点。这些结果以一致的顺序解析，其中两个结果提前了数月：快速排干在7月15日前解析，慢速排干在8月1日前解析，比可以计算完整季节管道的最早日期分别提前了92天和75天，埋藏和冻结随后分别提前44天和30天。另外五个学习器（从多数类底线和54个汇总统计量到基于触发器的早期分类器）保持了这种排序不变：尽管季末准确率相差高达18个百分点，但每个产生各类别轨迹的学习器都重现了它，并且它在留一流域评估中存活下来，尽管在未见季节中用机器学习标签替代专家标签则不然。我们在第$t$天计算的每个特征仅读取到$t$天的数据，代价最多为1.3个百分点。因此，监测系统不应该只有一个发布日期：快速 drainage 可以在7月15日被标记，比可以计算完整季节管道的时间早了三个月。
tldr: 格陵兰岛冰面湖泊的四种结局（如快速排干）可以在融冰季结束前数月（最早可提前3个月）被准确预测。
ai_comments: 该论文首次通过截断输入并结合多个分类器，证明了格陵兰岛冰盖上的冰面湖泊命运可以在融冰季结束前很早就被准确预测，这对研究冰川水文学和冰盖动力学具有重要意义。
motivation: 现有的卫星分类器只能在融冰季结束后准确恢复冰面湖泊的结局，而湖泊结局决定了融水是否会到达冰底，因此需要明确每种结局在季节中实际需要多少时间才能被准确预测。
method: 通过固定数据表示和分类器，在从5月1日至12月31日的14个时间截断点上截断输入数据并重新训练，记录每个类别达到固定目标$F_1$分数的最早截断点，并用多个不同的学习器进行鲁棒性验证。
results: 四种湖泊结局以一致的顺序显现，其中快速排干在7月15日前可辨（提前92天），慢速排干在8月1日前可辨（提前75天），埋藏和冻结分别提前44天和30天，这一排序在多种学习器和评估测试中保持稳健。
conclusion: 冰面湖泊的命运可以在融冰季结束前数周甚至数月被准确预测，其中快速排干可在7月15日被识别，为冰川水文监测系统提供了全新的时间节点。

title: Manacá-1B: An Open, Reproducible Brazilian-Portuguese Language Model and a Tokenizer-Aware, Paired Evaluation
authors: Bruno Leonardo Santos Menezes, Carlos Leonardo Souza Cardoso, Fabio Andre Machado Porto
abstract: Brazilian Portuguese remains under-served by open language models, and the few that exist are difficult to reproduce and are often compared without measures of uncertainty. We release Manacá-1B, an open decoder-only model of 1.72 billion parameters trained from scratch for Brazilian Portuguese with a fully containerized, reproducible pipeline. The pretraining is stable, with zero skipped or NaN steps and self-recovering loss spikes, and we release its full log and dynamics. We evaluate the model against nine open baselines on four Portuguese benchmarks under a single harness. Every comparison reports a standard error and a paired significance test, and the harness is validated against previously published numbers. On last-word prediction Manacá-1B is the strongest model below the 7B scale, exceeding both Tucano-1b1 and Tucano-2b4 on LAMBADA-PT with large paired margins; it is competitive on commonsense completion and near chance on multiple-choice reasoning, as are all small base models. Along the way we document a concrete evaluation pitfall: converting a SentencePiece tokenizer with case-folding normalization to the HuggingFace fast format silently drops the normalizer, routing every capitalized token to byte-fallback and depressing scores in a way that is invisible in aggregate metrics. The uncorrected tokenizer lowered LAMBADA-PT accuracy from 45.3 to 25.0; we quantify the effect and provide a one-line fix that reproduces the training tokenizer exactly. Code, raw training and evaluation logs, per-example prediction vectors, the model weights, and the corrected tokenizer are released so that every number in this paper can be recomputed.
zh_title: Manacá-1B：一个开源、可复现的巴西葡萄牙语语言模型及对分词器敏感的配对评测
translation: 巴西葡萄牙语在开源语言模型中一直未得到充分支持，现有的少数模型也很难复现，并且在比较时往往缺乏不确定性度量。我们发布了 Manacá-1B，这是一个拥有 1.72 十亿参数的开源解码器模型，通过完全容器化的可复现管道从头开始针对巴西葡萄牙语进行训练。其预训练过程非常稳定，没有跳过或 NaN 的步骤，且具备自动恢复的损失尖峰，我们同时发布了它的完整日志和动态数据。我们在单一评测框架下，使用四个葡萄牙语基准对该模型与九个开源基线进行了评估。每次对比都报告了标准误差和配对显著性检验，且该评测框架已通过先前发布的数据进行了验证。在末词预测任务上，Manacá-1B 是 7B 规模以下最强的模型，在 LAMBADA-PT 上以极大的配对优势超越了 Tucano-1b1 和 Tucano-2b4；它在常识补全上具有竞争力，但在多项选择推理上接近随机水平，所有小型基础模型皆是如此。在此过程中，我们记录了一个具体的评测陷阱：将带有大小写折叠归一化（case-folding normalization）的 SentencePiece 分词器转换为 HuggingFace 快速格式时，会静默丢弃归一化器，将每个大写标记路由到字节回退（byte-fallback），从而以聚合指标中无法察觉的方式降低分数。未纠正的分词器将 LAMBADA-PT 的准确率从 45.3 降低到 25.0；我们量化了这一影响并提供了一行代码的修复方案，以精确复现训练时的分词器。我们开源了代码、原始训练与评测日志、每个样本的预测向量、模型权重以及修正后的分词器，以便本文中的每个数字都可以被重新计算。
tldr: 本文发布了开源巴西葡萄牙语模型Manacá-1B，具备高可复现性与优秀的基准表现，并揭示了一个严重影响评测结果的分词器隐蔽漏洞。
ai_comments: Manacá-1B通过开源17.2亿参数的巴西葡萄牙语模型、提供完全可复现的训练流程以及揭示词表转换中的隐蔽评测陷阱，为小规模语言模型的研究做出了重要贡献。其严谨的配对显著性检验和全透明的日志显著提升了该领域的开源研究标准。
motivation: 巴西葡萄牙语在开源语言模型中长期被忽视，现有的少数模型存在难以复现且缺乏不确定性度量的问题，同时分词器在转换过程中可能存在隐蔽的评测陷阱。
method: 从头训练了一个17.2亿参数的解码器模型，使用完全容器化的可复现流程，并在统一的评测框架下与9个开源基线进行对比，采用了标准误差和配对显著性检验。
results: Manacá-1B在7B参数规模以下表现最强，在LAMBADA-PT上以显著优势超越Tucano-1b1和Tucano-2b4；同时发现并修复了一个因分词器归一化器丢失而导致LAMBADA-PT准确率从45.3跌至25.0的严重评测陷阱。
conclusion: Manacá-1B填补了巴西葡萄牙语开源小模型的空白，证明了从头训练专用模型的有效性，并强调了在模型评测中控制底层分词器细节和使用严谨统计检验的重要性。

title: Structure-Preserving Detailed-Balance Master-Equation Discretizations for Fokker--Planck Equations
authors: Satish Chandran, Yiwei Wang
abstract: We develop a variational--Markov construction of detailed-balance master-equation discretizations for Fokker--Planck equations directly from their energy--dissipation laws. Rather than discretizing the differential operator, we represent mass transfer between neighboring grid points by two directional jump rates. On each edge, the discrete energy--dissipation law determines the net flux, while detailed balance fixes the rate ratio; a local reconstruction of edge quantities from neighboring grid-point values then uniquely determines both rates. A logarithmic-mean reconstruction recovers the classical Scharfetter--Gummel/Wang--Peskin--Elston rates, while alternative reconstructions yield other reversible schemes. The resulting semi-discrete systems conserve mass, preserve nonnegativity, satisfy detailed balance, and dissipate a discrete free energy. The same edgewise construction extends to state-dependent and degenerate mobilities, nonlocal interaction energies and higher-dimensional problems. The corresponding implicit and semi-implicit fully discrete schemes are linear, mass-conservative, positivity-preserving, and energy-stable, with a time-step restriction required only for nonlocal interaction energies whose kernel is not negative semidefinite. Numerical experiments confirm the expected spatial convergence rates of all detailed-balance schemes and verify their equilibrium accuracy, positivity preservation, and free-energy decay with discontinuous potentials, saturation, nonlocal interactions, and two-dimensional problems.
zh_title: Fokker--Planck方程保持结构的详细平衡主方程离散化方法
translation: 我们直接从能量-耗散律出发，通过变分-马尔可夫构造开发了Fokker--Planck方程的详细平衡主方程离散化方法。与离散化微分算子不同，我们用两个方向的跳跃速率来表示相邻网格点之间的质量传递。在每条边上，离散的能量-耗散律确定了净通量，而详细平衡固定了速率比；随后从相邻网格点值对边上量的局部重建唯一确定了这两个速率。对数平均重建恢复了经典的Scharfetter--Gummel/Wang--Peskin--Elston速率，而替代重建则产生了其他可逆格式。由此产生的半离散系统具有质量守恒、非负性保持、满足详细平衡以及耗散离散自由能的特性。相同的边法构造扩展到了状态依赖和退化迁移率、非局域相互作用能以及更高维的问题。相应的隐式和半隐式全离散格式是线性的、质量守恒的、保正的和能量稳定的，仅对于核不是负半定非局域相互作用能才需要时间步长限制。数值实验证实了所有详细平衡格式预期的空间收敛速率，并验证了它们在不连续势能、饱和、非局域相互作用和二维问题中的平衡精度、保正性和自由能衰减。
tldr: 提出了一种保持物理结构（质量、非负性、详细平衡及能量耗散）的Fokker-Planck方程主方程离散化新方法。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于变分-马尔可夫构造的Fokker-Planck方程保持结构（如详细平衡、非负性、能量耗散等）的主方程离散化方法，具有很高的理论价值和广泛的适用性。

title: TPR-Attention for Combinatorial Generalization
authors: Melisa Civelekoğlu, Isabeau Prémont-Schwarz
abstract: Systematic generalization remains a significant challenge in deep learning. In particular, combinatorial generalization - generalizing to new configurations of known factors of variation - is effortless for humans but difficult for standard neural architectures that rely on statistical correlations rather than explicit structural representations. We introduce a new architectural component that embeds structured inductive bias into deep learning: an attention mechanism operating over tensor-product representations (TPRs). Through controlled experiments on compositional tasks, we show that this TPR-attention mechanism outperforms existing architectural components in combinatorial generalization. These results highlight the value of integrating explicit compositional structure into neural attention and point toward a promising path for models capable of systematic generalization.
zh_title: 用于组合泛化的TPR-Attention
translation: 系统性泛化仍然是深度学习中的一个重大挑战。特别是组合泛化——即对已知变化因子的新配置进行泛化——对人类来说轻而易举，但对于依赖统计相关性而非显式结构表示的标准神经架构来说却很困难。我们引入了一种新的架构组件，将结构化的归纳偏置嵌入到深度学习中：一种在张量积表示（TPRs）上运行的注意力机制。通过对组合任务的控制实验，我们表明这种TPR-attention机制在组合泛化方面优于现有的架构组件。这些结果突出了将显式组合结构整合到神经注意力机制中的价值，并为具备系统性泛化能力的模型指明了一条有前景的道路。

title: VIBE: Video Instruction-aligned Background music gEneration
authors: Aryan Vijay Bhosale, Vaibhavi Lokegaonkar, Vishnu Raj, Gouthaman KV, Sreyan Ghosh, Ramani Duraiswami, Lie Lu, Dinesh Manocha
abstract: Current video-to-music (V2M) models lack semantic control and fail to penalize instruction violations, largely due to their reliance on reconstruction objectives and the representational bottleneck of static cross-modal conditioning in Diffusion Autoregressive (DAR) architectures. To resolve this, we introduce VIBE, a novel text-and-video-to-music (T+V2M) generation model that leverages: (1) Conditioning Connection, a depth-wise cross-layer conditioning mechanism that dynamically bridges the planning and diffusion refinement heads and (2) a comprehensive reward modeling taxonomy, optimizing for both hard, verifiable constraints (e.g., tempo, key) and soft, subjective qualities (e.g., musicality, multimodal alignment) with a structured 5-stage training curriculum. Upon evaluation using audio-visual alignment, instruction following, and audio quality metrics, along with a subjective human evaluation study, we observe that VIBE demonstrates enhanced controllability and instruction adherence while performing comparably to most evaluated baselines on generation fidelity and multimodal alignment.

title: Aligning Multi-Trajectory Supervision with Policy Optimization for VLA Driving
authors: Tian Zhang, Zhuo Huang, Hongrui Ye, Yu Wu, Zengmao Wang, Kaixuan Zhou
abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) driving methods increasingly combine multi-trajectory imitation learning with group-relative policy optimization (GRPO), making trajectory selection critical to final performance. However, some high-scoring trajectories that improve imitation can degrade subsequent GRPO by inducing advantage estimates misaligned with the current policy's feasible behavior distribution, driving updates away from safe and compliant behaviors. To address this, we propose a novel framework that aligns multi-trajectory supervision with policy optimization. To address the policy gradient bias induced by infeasible noisy trajectories outside the feasible region, augmented trajectories are constrained to a neighboring manifold of the ground-truth feasible region, and a Pareto-optimality criterion is adopted in place of the conventional aggregate score, retaining only non-dominated candidates and thereby filtering out conflicting samples at the source. To ensure that expanded trajectory supervision is effectively absorbed during policy optimization, we introduce two complementary mechanisms: feasibility-first advantage assignment and dynamic distillation. The former adapts Pareto credit to the feasibility composition of each rollout group and guides fully infeasible groups toward safe references. The latter updates teacher trajectories across refinement rounds to continually transfer useful supervision. Together, they progressively translate the benefits of expanded supervision into policy improvement. On NAVSIM v1 and v2, our method achieves 91.4 PDMS and 89.1 EPDMS, respectively, under single-trajectory inference, and recovers 440 of 658 initially failed scenes, 11.1\% higher than the original GRPO baseline.

title: E-SENS: Exclusion-Sensitive Penalization for Negative-Constraint Retrieval
authors: Yerang Kim, Jiyoon Myung, Joohyung Han
abstract: Retrieval-augmented language models can fail to respect negative constraints when the retriever supplies evidence about concepts the user explicitly excluded. Beyond explicit negation, queries may ask for answers that include one concept while excluding another, or for entities that belong to a category but differ from a closely related instance. Because the excluded concept still appears in the query text, dense retrievers may assign high similarity to documents about that concept even when the user asks to avoid it. We introduce E-SENS, a training-free reranking method for negation-sensitive retrieval. E-SENS extracts a compact trap query for the excluded side and subtracts trap-query similarity from the original-query retrieval score. On ExcluIR, E-SENS shows a clear recall-violation trade-off across four embedding models and reduces trap retrieval at recall-preserving settings.

title: Efficient and High-Quality Depth Estimation via Pixel-Space Diffusion with Linear Attention
authors: Bingde Liu, Wu Ran, Jinglei Zhang, Huanhuan Yuan, Chao Ma
abstract: This work presents $\textbf{Lapis}$, a $\textbf{l}$inear-$\textbf{a}$ttention-based $\textbf{pi}$xel-$\textbf{s}$pace generative framework that achieves efficient and high-fidelity depth estimation with one-step diffusion. While generative frameworks have significantly advanced monocular depth estimation with superior detail fidelity, the $\mathcal{O}(N^2)$ complexity of standard attention and the multi-step denoising process introduce prohibitive computational costs when scaling them to high-resolution image applications. Although linear attention and one-step prediction are intuitively viable, directly applying them leads to poor structural consistency, detail loss, and noise. Lapis rectifies these limitations through a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Specifically, a Patch-level Consistency Module restores structural coherence by integrating semantic and spatial priors. Subsequently, a Pixel-level Refinement Module recovers sharp geometric boundaries via skip-connection-based pixel correspondence. Furthermore, to mitigate sampling noise inherent in one-step diffusion, we leverage the manifold assumption and adopt a direct $\mathbf{x}$-prediction strategy to target the clean data manifold. Extensive evaluations on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Lapis consistently achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) accuracy and boundary sharpness across various resolutions, reducing inference latency by up to 7.6$\times$ at 1080P and 10.9$\times$ at 1440P resolution compared to previous SOTA generative models.

title: LandmarkLens: Predicting and Presenting Effective Landmarks for Mixed-Reality Urban Exploration
authors: Chu Li, Yotam Sechayk, Jared Hwang, Jon E. Froehlich, Takeo Igarashi
abstract: People with a poor sense of direction (SOD) struggle to build cognitive maps for effective spatial navigation, and existing navigation tools prioritize efficiency over spatial learning. To understand how navigation strategies differ by ability, we conducted a landmark attention study with 20 participants (ten good SOD, ten poor SOD) who navigated across four Tokyo neighborhoods in virtual reality (VR). We found systematic group differences in both gaze behavior and the types of landmarks they verbally identify as effective. Based on these findings, we built LandmarkLens, a mixed-reality (MR) navigation system that uses a vision-language model (VLM) to identify and highlight navigation-relevant landmarks. A follow-up study with eight poor-SOD participants showed improved performance in scene recognition, suggesting that guided landmark attention can support landmark-level spatial knowledge acquisition for people with poor SOD, a first step toward broader spatial learning.

title: Balancing Privacy, Utility, and Safety in LLM Alignment through Preference Optimization
authors: Dishu Yang, Jingjing Liu, Jize Li
abstract: Preference optimization is widely used to align large language models with human preferences, but preference-data composition may also influence privacy-relevant memorization. We examine whether adding synthetic privacy-preference pairs to Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is associated with lower canary-based memorization signals without modifying the objective or introducing a formal privacy mechanism. We propose Privacy-Pressure Preference Mixing (P3M), a data-composition protocol that varies the amount of privacy-preference data while keeping helpfulness and harmlessness preference data fixed. We evaluate a non-privacy Baseline and privacy-mixing ratios of 0.5, 1.0, and 2.0 using Gemma 3 270M-IT across five random seeds and validate the same four conditions using 4-bit-quantized Gemma 2 2B-IT across three seeds. Overall, under the tested conditions, privacy-preference mixing is associated with lower mean canary suffix log-likelihood proxy values across both model settings and lower aggregate membership-inference attack performance relative to the Baseline in the mixed-source 2B evaluation. Specifically, across the privacy-aware 2B configurations, the mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) ranges from 0.596 to 0.629, and the mean area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) ranges from 0.541 to 0.575, compared with 0.804 and 0.790, respectively, for the Baseline. However, the reduction in membership distinguishability does not hold uniformly across data sources. Moreover, the relationship between the privacy ratio and harmlessness preference accuracy varies by model setting, whereas helpfulness preference accuracy remains broadly stable. These findings suggest that P3M should be viewed as a lightweight empirical protocol for examining privacy-utility-safety trade-offs rather than as a formal privacy guarantee or a defense against extraction attacks.

title: Repeatability Characterisation and Error Budget of a Consumer Structured-Light Scanner for 3-D Wound Geometry:A Rigid-Phantom Study
authors: Pushkal Kumar, Aadit Aggarwal, Karlen Aleksanyan
abstract: We characterise the measurement error of a free- hand consumer structured-light scanner used to derive three- dimensional geometric wound descriptors. Rigid wound-care phantoms cannot change, so every difference between repeat scans of one site is measurement error; all repeats come from a single scanner unit, nine sites and 23 scans, so this charac- terises one instrument. The 95 percent repeatability limit for reconstructed surface area is a factor of 4.8, with a confidence interval from 3.0 to 7.0, so rescanning an unchanged site can shift the reading from a 79 percent decrease to a 377 percent increase. Forty-four of 45 descriptors fall below an intraclass correlation of 0.50, and none of 248 descriptor and pipeline combinations reaches 0.75. An error budget formed by holding the analy- sis region fixed, leaving sensor and reconstruction untouched, bounds the share of variance attributable to how much surface the operator captured at 75 percent for surface area, 91 percent for hull area and 95 percent for bounding-box diagonal; only hull volume is majority instrumental, at 48 percent, so a better sensor would buy little. No wound is delineated anywhere in the chain, so the comparison against the four-week area reduction used clinically to predict healing, a ratio near 2.1, is a lower bound on the noise an unsegmented pipeline must overcome, not a measurement of wound-area reproducibility. Standardising the analysis region cuts the limit to 2.13, meeting that ratio rather than clearing it. Statistical outlier removal imposes a measured systematic area deficit near 11 percent.

title: Verification-Aware Training for Speculative Decoding
authors: Geonmo Gu, Byeongho Heo, HeeJae Jun, Yoohoon Kang, Sangmin Lee, Sangdoo Yun, Dongyoon Han
abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by using a draft model to generate candidate tokens, which are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Verification proceeds sequentially and discards every position from the first rejection onward, yet existing draft training relies on token-level imitation of the target with a fixed per-position weighting that reflects neither property. We introduce Verification-Aware Training (VAT), a plug-in framework that simulates verification at every training step and turns the resulting accept and reject patterns into supervision. VAT consists of two components: (i) a verification head, a lightweight jointly trained binary classifier that supervises the draft model on whether each position survives sequential verification; (ii) verification-adaptive weighting, which replaces the fixed weighting schedule by keeping full weight up to each sample's first rejection point and re-anchoring the decay to start there. VAT modifies only the training objective, so it can be layered on top of existing methods without changing the draft architecture, the target model, or the inference procedure. Applied to EAGLE-3 and DFlash on Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, and LLaMA-3.1-8B, VAT improves average acceptance length by up to 11.4% and wall-clock speedup by up to 8.7%, with consistent gains across math, code, and chat benchmarks. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/vat

title: Rethinking Language's Role in Efficient VLA for Autonomous Vehicles: Toward Smarter, Trustworthy Driving
authors: Tongfei Guo, Lili Su
abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are reshaping autonomous driving (AD) by unifying perception, reasoning, and control through language, enabling semantic grounding, interpretable decisions, and better long-tail generalization. But language is expensive onboard: latency and memory budgets are tight, and autoregressive decoding is inherently sequential. This work reframes the central question as when and where language should act at inference, since inference cost recurs at every deployed frame while training cost is paid once. We introduce the Language Residue taxonomy to organize methods by their inference-time use of language: train-time-only supervision (L1), latent non-textual reasoning (L2), conditional invocation (L3), and full per-frame generation (L4). We review representative methods and tag each across five deployment axes (latency, parameters, memory, FLOPs, tokens), analyzing them on major open- and closed-loop driving benchmarks (e.g., nuScenes, NAVSIM, Bench2Drive). We further trace how efficient methods from NLP/LLM are adapted in AD, identifying the constraints and motivations driving these adaptations. A continuously updated repository will be available at Github.

title: CAST: Critique-Aware Supervision for Training Reliable Long-Horizon Tool-Calling Agents
authors: Amir Saeidi, Zehua Zhang, Rishitosh Singh, Naman Ahuja, Vivek Gupta, Ali Payani, Gaowen Liu, Jayanth Srinivasa, Chitta Baral
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in long-horizon, interactive, and stateful environments. In these settings, a single wrong action, such as refunding the wrong purchase, can cause irreversible task failure and must be intercepted before execution. Such failures may not appear in every single run, but can emerge across repeated trials, making reliability across steps and trials critical. However, ensuring agentic reliability is challenging: even frontier LLMs struggle to explain why an action may be wrong, especially in long, intertwined trajectories governed by domain-specific policies. Much recent work relies on prompt-based critique agents, while optimization-based methods lack a systematic way to produce rich verification rationales for training. We address this gap with CAST, a critique-aware training framework that converts sparse task outcomes into action-level supervision for critique learning and policy optimization. CAST analyzes agent trajectories to synthesize structured rationales explaining action validity under partial observability. The resulting critique model is used to construct critique-aware training data for optimizing the policy model. Fine-tuning Qwen3-family models on dynamic tool-calling benchmarks, CAST improves reliability across domains, outperforming GPT-OSS-120B by over 10% pass^4 on Retail tasks and yielding an additional 9% improvement on Telehealth in an out-of-domain setting. These results demonstrate that critique-aware training improves the robustness of LLM agents in realistic dynamic environments.

title: Understanding before verifying: Claim normalization for automated citation verification
authors: Yifan He, Mengjia Wu, Siming Deng, Yi Zhang
abstract: Citation accuracy has been studied for decades because of its importance to research reliability. Content-level citation verification assesses the reliability of scholarly claims. Recent work adopts a two-stage retrieval-classification framework inherited from fact-checking. However, this design overlooks the complexity of the raw citing claim and introduces three issues into the verification system, namely scope mismatch, perspective mismatch, and proposition entanglement. These issues increase the difficulty of retrieval and classification, thereby limiting model performance. Motivated by this gap, we propose claim normalization, which applies three rewriting strategies to the raw citing claim before retrieval and classification, allowing each downstream model to perform a single, well-defined task. Building on this method, we develop Claim-Normalized Citation Verification (CNCV), a new three-stage framework consisting of claim normalization, evidence retrieval with grounding, and citation classification. We evaluate CNCV across 18 classifiers using a factorial experiment on human-annotated citation instances. Compared with the prior two-stage framework, CNCV improves macro F1 by an average of 12% for encoders and 10% for generative LLMs, driven by improved evidence quality, the dominant factor identified in our experiments. Evidence retrieved from automatically normalized claims yields downstream classification performance statistically equivalent to that obtained with manually annotated evidence.
