translation: 跨模态的情感线索可能是矛盾的（例如讽刺或嘲讽的表扬），如果只依赖单一模态可能会导致误解。大型音频语言模型（LALMs）最近受到广泛关注并被应用于多模态情感识别，但它们在不一致情况下解耦声学和语义线索的能力仍未得到充分探索。为了弥补这一空白，我们引入了CREMA-ASIS数据集，专门用于研究声学情感与语义情感线索之间的不一致性。它将声学情感标签与语义情感极性配对。利用该数据集，我们在多任务框架内评估了LALM的偏见，并进行了逐层分析以识别各层的模态优势。我们的研究结果表明，LALMs在处理语义-声学不一致的情况时表现挣扎，很少预测出不一致性，并且LALMs主要受语义信息的影响。然而，监督微调显著提高了LALM在我们的CREMA-ASIS测试集上的性能，同时保持了转录准确率和联合情感识别能力。结果证明了增强域外数据的声学和语义理解的潜力。
tldr: 本文发现大音频-语言模型在处理声调与语义不一致（如讽刺）时过度依赖语义，但通过监督微调可以有效纠正这一偏见。
ai_comments: 该论文切入点新颖，关注大音频-语言模型（LALMs）在声音语调与字面语义不一致时的表现，揭示了模型普遍存在的语义主导偏见，并通过监督微调验证了改进的潜力。
motivation: 为了探究大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在面对跨模态情感线索不一致（如讽刺或嘲讽）时，区分声学与语义线索的能力及其潜在偏见。
method: 构建了CREMA-ASIS数据集，在多任务框架下评估LALM的偏见，并进行逐层分析以确定不同层的模态主导性，同时应用监督微调提升模型性能。
results: 研究发现LALMs在处理语义-声学不一致情况时表现不佳，极少预测出不一致性，且主要受语义信息影响；而监督微调显著提升了LALM在CREMA-ASIS测试集上的性能，同时保持了转录准确率和联合情感识别能力。
conclusion: 大音频-语言模型在处理声学与语义不一致的情感表达时存在明显缺陷且偏向语义，但通过监督微调可以有效提升其处理不一致情况的能力，同时保持其他核心任务的性能。

title: Multimodal Deep Learning for Uncertainty-Aware Radiation Pneumonitis Risk Prediction
authors: Jin Yang, Tian Liu, Jing Wang, Robert Samstein, Kenneth Rosenzweig, Julie Bloom, Ming Chao
abstract: Radiation pneumonitis (RP) is a common and clinically significant toxicity of thoracic radiation therapy that can cause pulmonary morbidity and impair quality of life. Although conventional dose-volume histogram-based metrics and normal tissue complication probability models are widely used for RP risk assessment, they inadequately capture the complex spatial, anatomical, and patient-specific factors underlying radiation-induced lung injury. Recent machine learning approaches have improved RP risk prediction by integrating multimodal clinical and imaging information; however, most provide a point risk estimate without quantifying the reliability of individual predictions, limiting their potential clinical utility. We propose a Multimodal Bayesian Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) framework that jointly estimates RP risk and characterizes the sources of predictive uncertainty. MM-DiT integrates planning computed tomography (CT) images and three-dimensional radiation dose distributions through self-supervised multimodal pre-training, reducing reliance on limited and potentially noisy toxicity labels. The resulting representations are further refined using a latent diffusion transformer and transferred to a Bayesian prediction framework for probabilistic RP risk estimation. A learnable label-noise model is incorporated to explicitly account for uncertainty arising from imperfect toxicity annotations. Therefore, it provides individualized RP risk estimates with complementary measures of aleatoric, epistemic, and label uncertainty, enabling assessment of prediction reliability at the individual-patient level. We evaluated MM-DiT in two independent cohorts using complementary assessments of predictive discrimination, calibration, and uncertainty. The results demonstrate its potential to provide accurate RP risk estimates while quantifying clinically relevant sources of predictive uncertainty.
zh_title: 用于不确定性感知的放射性肺炎风险预测的多模态深度学习
translation: 放射性肺炎（RP）是胸部放射治疗中常见且具有临床意义的毒性，会导致肺部发病率并损害生活质量。尽管传统的基于剂量-体积直方图的指标和正常组织并发症概率模型被广泛用于RP风险评估，但它们未能充分捕捉辐射引起的肺损伤背后的复杂空间、解剖和患者特异性因素。最近的机器学习方法通过整合多模态临床和影像信息改善了RP风险预测，然而，大多数方法仅提供点风险估计，而没有量化单个预测的可靠性，限制了它们的潜在临床效用。我们提出了一个多模态贝叶斯扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）框架，该框架联合估计RP风险并表征预测不确定性的来源。MM-DiT通过自监督多模态预训练整合了计划计算断层扫描（CT）图像和三维放射剂量分布，减少了对有限且可能存在噪声的毒性标签的依赖。由此产生的表示使用潜在扩散Transformer进一步精炼，并转移到贝叶斯预测框架中进行概率性RP风险估计。结合了一个可学习的标签噪声模型，以明确解释源自不完美毒性注释的不确定性。因此，它提供了具有同质性、认知性和标签不确定性补充度量的个体化RP风险估计，能够在个体患者水平评估预测可靠性。我们在两个独立队列中评估了MM-DiT，使用了预测区分度、校准和不确定性的互补评估。结果证明了其在提供准确的RP风险估计的同时量化临床相关预测不确定性来源的潜力。
tldr: 提出了一种能够量化个体预测不确定性的多模态深度学习框架，用于准确预测放射性肺炎风险。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将多模态数据（CT与剂量分布）、自监督预训练、潜空间扩散Transformer以及贝叶斯不确定性量化框架相结合，不仅能预测放射性肺炎风险，还能评估预测结果的可靠性，具有很高的临床应用价值。
motivation: 常规的剂量体积直方图指标和正常组织并发症概率模型无法充分捕捉辐射所致肺损伤的复杂因素；现有机器学习方法虽整合了多模态信息，但通常只能给出点风险估计而无法量化个体预测的可靠性，限制了临床应用。
method: 提出多模态贝叶斯扩散Transformer (MM-DiT) 框架，结合自监督多模态预训练整合计划CT图像与3D辐射剂量分布，利用潜空间扩散Transformer精炼表示，并结合贝叶斯预测框架及可学习的标签噪声模型进行概率性RP风险估计。
results: 在两个独立队列中的评估表明，MM-DiT在预测区分度、校准度和不确定性方面表现良好，能够提供准确的RP风险估计并量化不确定性来源。
conclusion: MM-DiT框架在两个独立队列上的评估表明，它能够提供准确的RP风险估计，同时有效量化临床相关的预测不确定性来源。

title: A Continuous Payload-Bearing Discrete Multitone Modulation Framework for Fiber-Optic Integrated Sensing and Communication
authors: Huan Huang, Ziang Chen, Zhiyang Xue, Dongdong Zou, Yi Cai
abstract: A key challenge in fiber-optic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is to make the payload-bearing waveform itself serve both functions without a separate sensing waveform or sensing-only silent interval. We propose a continuous discrete multitone (DMT) framework with two waveform modes, in which the same payload-bearing waveform supports forward intensity-modulation/direct-detection (IM/DD) communication and backward distributed acoustic sensing (DAS). A unified phase-sensitive optical time-domain reflectometry (φ-OTDR) model represents distributed Rayleigh backscattering as a finite-memory sensing multipath channel. It shows that conventional pulse-and-wait φ-OTDR requires a round-trip-time-scale silent interval to isolate successive returns, while nonzero off-peak samples in practical matched-filter (MF) pulse compression cause spatial intersymbol interference (ISI). Continuous DMT instead retains superposed returns and separates range-cell contributions through known-waveform channel reconstruction. Cyclic-prefix DMT (CP-DMT) uses a full-memory CP and one-tap frequency-domain equalization (FDE); under sufficient-CP and ideal full-bin inversion conditions, it eliminates MF-correlation-induced spatial ISI. Cyclic-prefix-free DMT (NoCP-DMT) applies regularized least squares (LS) to the long-memory linear convolution, avoiding the CP at higher receiver complexity. Experiments over a 10-km fiber link localize a 600-Hz disturbance applied by a piezoelectric transducer (PZT) near 5.071 km and recover gauge-differential phase with correlations of 0.989 and 0.987 for CP-DMT and NoCP-DMT, respectively. At 2- and 1-V PZT drive levels, the ten-record localization standard deviations are 0.16/0.11 m and 0.18/0.38 m, respectively. The corresponding IM/DD error vector magnitude values range from 4.80% to 5.00%, with no bit errors observed.

title: Patch-Based Diffusion Reconstruction for Accelerated Cardiac Cine
authors: Xuan Lei, Philip Schniter, Juliet Varghese, Rizwan Ahmad
abstract:
Purpose: To develop and evaluate a diffusion-based reconstruction framework for highly accelerated 2D real-time (RT) cine cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging (CMR).
  Methods: We trained an unconditional patch-based diffusion model and incorporated it into a reconstruction framework, termed CineDiff, using diffusion posterior sampling for data consistency. CineDiff was evaluated in four settings: (i) 30 retrospectively undersampled breath-held cine at 1.5T and 3T from healthy participants across multiple acceleration rates, (ii) 15 prospectively undersampled free-breathing RT cine at 1.5T and 3T from patients indicated for clinical CMR, and (iii) 10 prospectively undersampled mid-field (0.55T) free-breathing scans, including five from healthy subjects and five from porcine models. For retrospective undersampling, reconstruction quality was assessed using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index measure (SSIM), learned perceptual image patch similarity (LPIPS), and deep image structure and texture similarity (DISTS). For prospective undersampling, image quality was evaluated by blinded expert scoring on a 5-point Likert scale.
  Results: In retrospectively undersampled breath-held cine data, CineDiff achieved higher PSNR and SSIM and lower LPIPS and DISTS than the comparison methods across all evaluated acceleration rates. In prospectively undersampled free-breathing RT cine data, CineDiff received higher expert image-quality scores. Qualitatively, CineDiff reduced block-like artifacts and preserved finer anatomical detail compared with traditional compressed sensing and a variational network method, termed CineVN.
  Conclusion: CineDiff enabled high-quality reconstruction of highly accelerated 2D RT cine CMR. The method also demonstrated robustness to out-of-distribution data, including mid-field and porcine acquisitions.
zh_title: 用于加速心脏电影成像的基于图块的扩散重建方法
translation:
目的：开发并评估一个基于扩散的重建框架，用于高度加速的 2D 实时（RT）电影心血管磁共振（CMR）成像。
方法：我们训练了一个无条件的基于图块的扩散模型，并将其纳入一个名为 CineDiff 的重建框架中，该框架使用扩散后验采样来实现数据一致性。CineDiff 在四种设置下进行了评估：(i) 来自健康参与者的 30 个回顾性欠采样屏气电影数据（1.5T 和 3T，跨多个加速率），(ii) 来自临床 CMR 指征患者的 15 个前瞻性欠采样自由呼吸 RT 电影数据（1.5T 和 3T），以及 (iii) 10 个前瞻性欠采样中场（0.55T）自由呼吸扫描（其中 5 个来自健康受试者，5 个来自猪模型）。对于回顾性欠采样，重建质量通过峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性指数（SSIM）、学习感知图像图块相似度（LPIPS）以及深度图像结构和纹理相似度（DISTS）进行评估。对于前瞻性欠采样，图像质量通过盲法专家打分（5点李克特量表）进行评估。
结果：在回顾性欠采样屏气电影数据中，CineDiff 在所有评估的加速率下均取得了比对比方法更高的 PSNR 和 SSIM，以及更低的 LPIPS 和 DISTS。在前瞻性欠采样自由呼吸 RT 电影数据中，CineDiff 获得了更高的专家图像质量评分。在定性方面，与传统的压缩感知和名为 CineVN 的变分网络方法相比，CineDiff 减少了块状伪影并保留了更精细的解剖细节。
结论：CineDiff 实现了高度加速 2D RT 电影 CMR 的高质量重建。该方法还表现出对外分布数据的鲁棒性，包括中场和猪的采集数据。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 CineDiff 的扩散模型重建框架，用于实现高质量、高加速的心脏电影磁共振成像，并在多种场强和数据设置下展现出优异的重建性能与鲁棒性。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于图块（patch-based）的扩散模型重建框架 CineDiff，用于加速心脏电影磁共振成像。其创新之处在于将无条件扩散模型与后验采样相结合，并在多种场强（如0.55T、1.5T、3T）以及回顾性和前瞻性加速采集数据上验证了其鲁棒性和优越性，显著减少了块状伪影并保留了精细结构。
motivation: 开发并评估一个基于扩散的重建框架，用于高加速的 2D 实时（RT）电影心血管磁共振成像（CMR），以解决传统方法中存在的伪影和细节丢失问题。
method: 训练了一个无条件的基于图块的扩散模型，并将其结合到使用扩散后验采样进行数据一致性的重建框架（CineDiff）中。通过在多组回顾性和前瞻性欠采样数据（涵盖1.5T、3T及0.55T场强、健康受试者、临床患者及猪模型）上进行评估。

title: Beyond Speech: Dual-Domain SSL Fusion for Unified All-Type Audio Deepfake Detection
authors: Cunhang Fan, Junqin Cao, Tian Gao, Zhipeng Xie, Jun Xue, Zhao Lv, Xin Fang
abstract: Unified all-type audio deepfake detection aims to determine whether an input clip is real or fake when its audio type may be speech, environmental sound, singing voice, or music. Existing speech-centric or type-dependent solutions are insufficient for this setting because the test-time audio type is unknown, while the required output is still a single binary decision. To address these issues, this paper proposes a dual-domain SSL fusion method that maps heterogeneous audio into a shared binary authenticity space. EAT-large and wav2vec 2.0 XLS-R-300M are used as complementary SSL feature sources, providing broad acoustic and event-level representations as well as waveform-level, vocal, and speech-sensitive representations. Layer-wise weighted fusion integrates multi-level artifacts from different transformer depths, while token-level fusion forms a unified feature pool without enforcing frame-level alignment between the two SSL streams. The fused tokens are summarized by multi-head attentive statistics pooling and classified with a binary MLP head. With conservative speech refinement applied on top of this unified core detector, the submitted system achieves 95.58% Macro-F1 on the AT-ADD Track 2 evaluation set and ranks second in the challenge.
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures; accepted to the AT-ADD Grand Challenge at ACM Multimedia 2026 (MM '26)
zh_title: 超越语音：用于统一全类型音频深度伪造检测的双域SSL融合
translation: 统一的全类型音频深度伪造检测旨在确定输入片段在音频类型可能是语音、环境声、歌声或音乐时是真实还是伪造。现有的以语音为中心或依赖类型的解决方案对于这种设置是不够的，因为测试时的音频类型是未知的，而所需的输出仍然是单一的二元决策。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种双域SSL融合方法，将异构音频映射到共享的二元真实性空间中。EAT-large和wav2vec 2.0 XLS-R-300M被用作互补的SSL特征源，提供广泛的声学和事件级表示以及波形级、声乐和语音敏感表示。层级加权融合整合了来自不同Transformer深度的多级伪影，而Token级融合形成了一个统一的特征池，而不强制两个SSL流之间进行帧级对齐。融合后的Token通过多头注意力统计池化进行总结，并使用二元MLP头进行分类。在统一核心检测器之上应用保守的语音精细调整后，提交的系统在AT-ADD赛道2评估集上取得了95.58%的Macro-F1，并在该挑战赛中排名第二。
tldr: 提出了一种双域SSL融合方法，实现了跨语音、环境音、歌声和音乐等多种音频类型的统一深度伪造检测。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种双域自监督学习（SSL）融合方法，用于统一的各类音频深度伪造检测。通过结合不同SSL模型的优势（如EAT和wav2vec 2.0），并采用层级加权融合与Token级融合，成功解决了测试时音频类型未知的难题，在挑战赛中取得了优异成绩。创新点在于打破了传统的语音中心局限，实现了跨音频类型的统一真伪判别。
motivation: 现有的以语音为中心或依赖特定类型的音频深度伪造检测方案，在测试时音频类型未知（如语音、环境音、歌声或音乐）且需要输出单一二分类决策的场景下显得不足，因此需要开发一种统一的各类音频深度伪造检测方法。
method: 采用EAT-large和wav2vec 2.0 XLS-R-300M作为互补的SSL特征源；利用层级加权融合整合多层Transformer深度的伪影；通过Token级融合构建统一特征池；最后通过多头注意力统计池化和MLP分类头进行二分类，并辅以保守的语音精细调整。
results: 提交的系统在AT-ADD Track 2评估集上达到了95.58%的Macro-F1分数，并在该挑战赛中获得第二名。
conclusion: 本文提出的双域SSL融合方法能够有效应对未知音频类型的深度伪造检测任务，在AT-ADD挑战赛中取得了第二名的好成绩，展示了强大的泛化能力。

title: Manifold-Constrained PET Reconstruction with Learned Flow-Matching Priors
authors: Hengjia Ran, Jie Luo, Yutao Zhu, Rui Hu, Huafeng Liu, Bo Zhao
abstract: Image reconstruction for positron emission tomography (PET) is an ill-posed Poisson inverse problem that often suffers from severe noise amplification and artifacts. In this work, we introduce an unsupervised, optimization-based reconstruction framework that employs a flow-matching generative model as a learned manifold prior. We train the flow-matching model on high-quality PET images to learn a deterministic ordinary differential equation transport from a Gaussian latent distribution to the empirical PET image distribution, yielding a differentiable generator of anatomically plausible images. We incorporate this generator as an explicit manifold constraint into a regularized Poisson likelihood formulation. We solve the resulting optimization problem using an alternating direction method of multipliers algorithm, in which an expectation-maximization-type surrogate update enforces data consistency and a gradient-based latent-space projection enforces manifold proximity. We evaluate the proposed method on both simulated and real PET datasets, assessing dose-level robustness, lesion-insertion generalization, and cross-scanner transfer. Compared with conventional reconstruction methods and state-of-the-art deep learning baselines, the proposed method provides superior noise suppression, structural preservation, and quantitative accuracy, while maintaining high computational efficiency.

title: Movable Antenna Arrays with Imperfect Channel State Information in Rich Scattering Environments
authors: Yizhen Zhao, Amna Irshad, Emil Bjornson
abstract: The growing demand for high spectral efficiency in 6G and beyond has driven research into adaptive antenna architectures capable of exploiting the spatial structure of multipath propagation channels. Conventional base station arrays are deployed with fixed element positions and cannot adapt to the instantaneous spatial structure of the propagation channel. In contrast, movable antenna (MA) systems enable dynamic reconfiguration of antenna positions, allowing the array geometry to track the channel characteristics of the current user set. While prior MA studies have demonstrated significant gains under perfect or statistical channel state information (CSI) assumptions, the interplay between imperfect instantaneous CSI, antenna placement optimization, and precoder design has received limited attention. This paper addresses this gap by proposing a practical end-to-end framework encompassing uplink pilot transmission, MMSE channel estimation under a clustered multipath model, and downlink ZF precoding designed from estimated CSI. Antenna positions are optimized via particle swarm optimization under two objectives: sum-rate maximization and max-min fairness. Simulation results show that MA gains are most pronounced under sparse, near-LoS propagation and diminish as channel richness increases. Furthermore, we reveal a fundamental coupling between array geometry and precoder design: a fairness-oriented antenna geometry encodes spatial fairness information that is only recoverable when evaluated with a compatible power allocation strategy. A mismatched precoder can completely mask the geometric advantage, leading to misleading conclusions about the robustness of antenna placement to the choice of optimization objective. These findings provide practically relevant guidance for the design and evaluation of movable antenna systems under realistic operating conditions.
zh_title: 丰富散射环境中具有不完美信道状态信息的移动天线阵列
translation: 面向6G及未来更高频谱效率的需求，研究能够利用多径传播电信空间结构自适应天线架构的兴趣日益增长。传统的基站阵列采用固定天元位置部署，无法适应传播信道的瞬时空间结构。相比之下，移动天线（MA）系统能够动态重构天线位置，允许阵列几何结构追踪当前用户集的信道特征。虽然先前的MA研究在完美或统计信道状态信息（CSI）假设下展示了显著增益，但关于不完美瞬时CSI、天线放置优化与预编码设计之间的相互作用受到的关注有限。本文提出一个实用的端到端框架来填补这一空白，该框架涵盖了上行导频传输、基于群多径模型的MMSE信道估计以及利用估计CSI设计的下行ZF预编码。通过粒子群优化算法，在求和速率最大化和最大-最小公平性两个目标下优化天线位置。仿真结果表明，MA增益在稀疏、近视距传播下最为显著，并随着信道丰富度的增加而减小。此外，我们揭示了阵列几何结构与预编码设计之间的基本耦合关系：公平导向的天线几何结构编码了空间公平性信息，只有在采用兼容的功率分配策略评估时才能恢复。不匹配的预编码器会完全掩盖几何优势，从而导致关于天线布局对优化目标选择鲁棒性的误导性结论。这些发现在现实操作条件下为移动天线系统的设计和评估提供了切实相关的指导。
tldr: 本文研究了不完美CSI下移动天线系统的天线位置优化与预编码设计，揭示了阵列几何与预编码的紧密耦合性。
ai_comments: 该论文填补了移动天线系统在不完美瞬时CSI、天线位置优化和预编码设计交叉领域的研究空白，揭示了阵列几何结构与预编码设计的深层耦合关系，具有重要的理论和实用指导意义。
motivation: 以往的移动天线（MA）研究主要集中在完美或统计信道状态信息（CSI）假设下，而关于不完美瞬时CSI、天线位置优化以及预编码设计三者相互影响的研究较少，因此本文旨在填补这一现实场景下的研究空白。
method: 提出了一个包含上行导频传输、基于集群多径模型的MMSE信道估计以及利用估计CSI进行下行ZF预编码的端到端实用框架，并通过粒子群优化算法在求和速率最大化和最大-最小公平性两个目标下优化天线位置。
results: 仿真结果表明，MA增益在稀疏、近视距（near-LoS）传播下最明显，随着信道丰富度的增加而减小；此外，揭示了阵列几何结构与预编码设计之间的基本耦合关系，即不匹配的预编码器会完全掩盖几何优势。
conclusion: 移动天线（MA）系统在现实的不完美CSI环境下仍能带来性能增益，但其增益高度依赖于信道丰富度以及天线几何优化与预编码策略的匹配。

title: Sound Analysis for Speed Estimation of Induction Motors Under Non-Stationary Conditions
authors: Tomas A. Garcia-Calva, Daniel Morinigo-Sotelo, Konstantinos N. Gyftakis
abstract: This paper presents a novel methodology for the estimation of the rotational speed of induction motors operating under non stationary conditions, using acoustic signals acquired by a low cost microphone. The proposed approach integrates multi rate digital signal processing with advanced time frequency analysis to extract speed dependent harmonic components from motor acoustic emissions, while effectively suppressing electrical interference and electromagnetic noise. Numerical simulations and experimental validations are conducted under both steady state and transient operating conditions, considering a wide variety of speed profiles, including slow ramps and abrupt speed variations. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method is capable of accurately tracking rapid and dynamic speed changes caused by load disturbances and mechanical irregularities. The estimated instantaneous speed exhibits a high degree of agreement with reference measurements obtained from a conventional speed sensor. The results confirm that the proposed acoustic based technique provides a reliable, noninvasive, and cost effective solution suitable for speed monitoring of induction motors.
zh_title: 非平稳条件下感应电机转速估计的声学分析
translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，利用低成本麦克风采集的声学信号，在非平稳运行条件下估计感应电机的转速。所提出的方法将多速率数字信号处理与先进的时频分析相结合，以提取电机声学辐射中的转速相关谐波分量，同时有效抑制电气干扰和电磁噪声。在稳态和瞬态运行条件下（考虑了慢速斜坡和突变速度等多种速度曲线）进行了数值模拟和实验验证。实验结果表明，该方法能够准确追踪由负载扰动和机械不规则性引起的快速动态速度变化。估计出的瞬时速度与从传统速度传感器获得的参考测量结果高度吻合。结果证实，所提出的基于声学技术的方法为感应电机速度监测提供了一种可靠、非侵入式且具有成本效益的解决方案。
tldr: 提出了一种利用低成本麦克风和声学信号分析，在非平稳条件下对感应电机转速进行非侵入式且高精度估计的新方法。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地利用低成本麦克风通过声学信号实现对非平稳状态下感应电机转速的估计，结合了多速率数字信号处理和先进的时频分析方法，具有非侵入式、成本低且抗电磁干扰等显著优点，在工业电机监测领域有很好的应用前景。
motivation: 为了解决在非平稳运行条件下对感应电机转速进行可靠、非侵入式且低成本估计的需求。
method: 集成多速率数字信号处理与先进的时频分析方法，从电机声学发射中提取与转速相关的谐波分量，同时抑制电气干扰和电磁噪声。
results: 数值仿真和实验验证表明，该方法能够准确追踪由负载扰动和机械不规则性引起的快速动态速度变化，估计出的瞬时转速与传统速度传感器的参考测量结果高度一致。
conclusion: 提出的基于声学信号的感应电机非平稳转速估计方法是可靠的、非侵入式的且具有成本效益的，能够有效应对各种动态速度变化。

title: A New Paradigm of 6G Networks: Proactive Channel Cognition and Reconfiguration
authors: Wenyan Ma, Zixiang Ren, Weitong Zhai, Ge Yan, Lipeng Zhu, Zhenyu Xiao, Rui Zhang
abstract: The sixth-generation (6G) wireless networks are expected to enable the deep integration of communication, sensing, computing, control, and intelligence in highly dynamic environments. This evolution drives a fundamental transition from conventional passive channel adaptation to proactive channel cognition and reconfiguration, wherein wireless channels are no longer regarded as uncontrollable propagation media but as network resources that can be learned, predicted, and actively reconfigured. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of this emerging paradigm. We first review channel cognition through the channel knowledge map (CKM) as a systematic framework for learning and exploiting channel characteristics across space, time, and frequency domain. The definitions, construction methods, and applications in wireless networks of CKMs are comprehensively reviewed. Building upon channel cognition, we then review channel reconfiguration technologies from two complementary perspectives: transceiver-side reconfiguration enabled by movable antennas (MAs) and environment-side reconfiguration enabled by intelligent reflecting surfaces (IRSs). For both MA- and IRS-enabled wireless systems, we review their architectures, performance advantages, and key design challenges. Finally, we discuss several promising research directions to inspire further innovations in this burgeoning field.
zh_title: 6G网络新范式：主动信道认知与重构
translation: 第六代（6G）无线网络有望在高度动态的环境中实现通信、传感、计算、控制和智能的深度融合。这种演进推动了从传统的被动信道适应向主动信道认知与重构的根本性转变，其中无线信道不再被视为不可控的传播介质，而是可以被学习、预测和主动重构的网络资源。本文对这一新兴范式进行了全面的综述。我们首先通过信道知识图谱（CKM）回顾了信道认知，将其作为跨空间、时间和频率域学习和利用信道特性的系统框架。全面回顾了CKM的定义、构建方法及其在无线网络中的应用。在信道认知的基础上，我们从两个互补的角度回顾了信道重构技术：由可移动天线（MAs）实现的收发端重构和由智能反射面（IRSs）实现的环境侧重构。对于启用MA和IRS的无线系统，我们回顾了它们的架构、性能优势和关键设计挑战。最后，我们讨论了几个有前景的研究方向，以激发该新兴领域的进一步创新。
tldr: 本文综述了6G网络中将无线信道从被动适应转变为主动认知与重构的新范式，重点探讨了信道知识图谱、可移动天线和智能反射面等核心技术。
ai_comments: 该论文系统地总结了6G网络中从被动信道适应向主动信道认知与重构转变的新范式，突出了信道知识图谱（CKM）、可移动天线（MA）和智能反射面（IRS）的核心作用，对于理解未来6G网络设计具有重要的指导意义。
motivation: 为了应对第六代（6G）无线网络在高度动态环境中对通信、感知、计算、控制和智能深度融合的需求，克服传统被动信道适应的局限性，将无线信道转变为可学习、可预测和可主动重构的网络资源。
method: 本文通过文献综述与架构分析的方法，首先回顾了基于信道知识图谱（CKM）的信道认知框架，接着从发射端（可移动天线MA）和环境侧（智能反射面IRS）两个互补角度审视了信道重构技术，最后探讨了未来的研究方向。
results: 论文全面梳理了信道知识图谱（CKM）的定义、构建方法及其在无线网络中的应用，深入分析了可移动天线（MA）和智能反射面（IRS）的系统架构、性能优势及设计挑战，并指出了多个有前景的研究方向。
conclusion: 主动信道认知与重构是6G网络的关键演进方向，通过结合CKM、MA和IRS等技术，能够将原本不可控的传播媒介转化为可控的网络资源，从而满足6G在动态环境下的高性能需求。

title: Robust Decentralized Multi-Satellite Massive MIMO Transmission via Knowledge Distillation
authors: Wenjing Cao, Zheng Lin, Yafei Wang, Wenjin Wang, Ye Wang, Rui Ding, Symeon Chatzinotas, Björn Ottersten
abstract: This paper investigates robust decentralized transmission for cooperative multi-satellite massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems under imperfect statistical channel state information (sCSI). In the considered scenario, each satellite has complete access to its local information but receives partial information from other satellites due to limited inter-satellite links (ISLs), with only imperfect sCSI available. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge distillation (KD) framework that transfers cooperative precoding knowledge from a centralized teacher neural network (NN) to lightweight decentralized student NNs. Specifically, a global-clean teacher, aggregating information from all satellites and accessing accurate sCSI during offline training, transfers its cooperative precoding knowledge to partial-noisy students, relying on complete local information, limited information exchanged by other satellites, and error-corrupted sCSI for local precoding. The teacher NN combines patch-wise self-attention with dual-axis attention to learn inter-user interference and inter-satellite coordination, whereas each student NN adopts a compact per-satellite architecture for efficient onboard inference. The teacher learns a high-quality weighted minimum mean square error precoding policy from global-clean inputs, which is then distilled into the students operating on partial-noisy inputs. To mitigate the resulting teacher-student performance gap, we develop a hybrid KD mechanism with explicit angle- and phase-error calibration. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly enhances the decentralized sum-rate performance and remains robust under diverse configurations.

zh_title: 基于知识蒸馏的鲁棒去中心化多卫星大规模MIMO传输
translation: 本文研究了不完美统计信道状态信息（sCSI）下合作多卫星大规模多输入多输出（MIMO）系统的鲁棒去中心化传输。在所考虑的场景中，由于星间链路（ISL）有限且只能获得不完美的sCSI，每个卫星可以完全访问其本地信息，但只能从其他卫星接收部分信息。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种知识蒸馏（KD）框架，将集中式教师神经网络（NN）的合作预编码知识迁移到轻量级的去中心化学生NN中。具体而言，全局干净的教师网络在离线训练期间聚合来自所有卫星的信息并访问准确的sCSI，将其合作预编码知识迁移到依赖于完整本地信息、其他卫星交换的有限信息以及用于本地预编码的误差污染sCSI的部分噪声学生网络中。教师NN结合了块状自注意力机制和双轴注意力机制来学习用户间干扰和卫星间协调，而每个学生NN则采用紧凑的每卫星架构以进行高效的星上推理。教师网络从全局干净的输入中学习高质量的加权最小均方误差预编码策略，然后将其蒸馏到操作于部分噪声输入的学生网络中。为了减轻由此产生的教师-学生性能差距，我们开发了一种具有显式角度和相位误差校准的混合KD机制。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架显著增强了去中心化的和速率性能，并在各种配置下保持了鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于知识蒸馏的多卫星大规模MIMO去中心化传输框架，有效解决了星间链路受限和信道信息不完美的问题，实现了高效且鲁棒的星上预编码。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将知识蒸馏（KD）应用于多卫星大规模MIMO系统的去中心化传输中，有效解决了星间链路受限和信道状态信息不完美（imperfect sCSI）带来的挑战。通过提出混合KD机制与显式的角度-相位误差校准，显著缩小了教师与学生模型之间的性能差距，展现出良好的鲁棒性和高效的星上推理能力。
motivation: 在合作多卫星大规模MIMO系统中，由于星间链路（ISL）有限且只能获得不完美的统计信道状态信息（sCSI），传统的集中式传输方案难以实现高效的去中心化部署，因此需要设计一种能够在不完美和受限信息下实现鲁棒且高效的去中心化传输框架。
method: 提出一个知识蒸馏（KD）框架，将集中式教师神经网络（使用全局干净输入）的合作预编码知识迁移到轻量级去中心化学生神经网络（使用局部、部分和噪声输入）中；教师NN结合块状自注意力与双轴注意力，学生NN采用紧凑的每卫星架构，并开发了带有显式角度和相位误差校准的混合KD机制来缓解性能差距。
results: 仿真结果表明，所提出的框架显著提升了去中心化系统的和速率性能，并且在各种配置下均保持了强大的鲁棒性。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于知识蒸馏的去中心化多卫星大规模MIMO传输框架，成功克服了不完美sCSI和有限星间链路带来的挑战，显著提升了系统的和速率性能，且在多种配置下表现出强大的鲁棒性。

title: KDGen-BF: A Generative Site-Specific Multi-User Beamforming Approach
authors: Ruihang Jiang, Zhaolin Wang, Yuanwei Liu
abstract: This paper proposes knowledge-distilled generative beamforming (KDGen-BF) framework for site-specific multi-user beamforming. KDGen-BF generates a multi-user beamforming weights from low-dimensional reference signal received power (RSRP) observations without acquiring instantaneous channel state information (CSI). To address the ambiguity caused by limited RSRP observations and interference coupling, KDGen-BF formulates multi-user beamforming as a conditional generation problem and directly outputs beamforming weights beyond a finite codebook. A diffusion transformer is trained through knowledge-distillation and exponential-moving-average (KD-EMA) guidance, and multi-candidate strategy is used for online deployment. Numerical results on multiple DeepMIMO scenarios demonstrate that: 1) under limited probing budgets, KDGen-BF outperforms all baselines; 2) with larger probing budgets, KDGen-BF achieves performance comparable to exhaustive search over the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) codebook and outperforms all other baselines; and 3) under noisy RSRP observations, KDGen-BF remains robust and outperforms all compared baselines.
zh_title: KDGen-BF：一种生成式特定场景多用户波束成形方法
translation: 本文提出了一个用于特定场景多用户波束成形的知识蒸馏生成式波束成形（KDGen-BF）框架。KDGen-BF无需获取瞬时信道状态信息（CSI），即可从低维参考信号接收功率（RSRP）观测值生成多用户波束成形权重。为了解决有限RSRP观测值和干扰耦合引起的模糊性，KDGen-BF将多用户波束成形建模为一个条件生成问题，并直接输出超越有限码本的波束成形权重。通过知识蒸馏和指数移动平均（KD-EMA）引导训练扩散Transformer，并在在线部署时采用多候选策略。在多个DeepMIMO场景上的数值结果表明：1）在有限的探测预算下，KDGen-BF优于所有基线；2）在更大的探测预算下，KDGen-BF实现了与离散傅里叶变换（DFT）码本穷举搜索相当的性能，并优于所有其他基线；3）在有噪声的RSRP观测下，KDGen-BF保持鲁棒性并优于所有对比基线。
tldr: 提出了一种名为KDGen-BF的生成式多用户波束成形方法，无需瞬时CSI，仅通过低维RSRP观测值即可高效且鲁棒地生成波束成形权重。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种基于知识蒸馏和扩散Transformer的生成式特定场景多用户波束成形框架KDGen-BF，创新性地利用低维RSRP观测值直接生成连续的波束成形权重，摆脱了对瞬时CSI和有限码本的依赖，在性能和鲁棒性上均表现优异。
motivation: 为了解决传统多用户波束成形需要获取瞬时信道状态信息（CSI）的难题，以及有限RSRP观测值和干扰耦合带来的模糊性问题。
method: 提出KDGen-BF框架，将多用户波束成形建模为条件生成问题，采用通过知识蒸馏和指数移动平均（KD-EMA）引导训练的扩散Transformer，并在在线部署时使用多候选策略。
results: 数值结果表明，在有限的探测预算下，KDGen-BF优于所有基线；在较大的探测预算下，其性能与DFT码本的穷举搜索相当并优于其他基线；在有噪声的RSRP观测下，它保持了鲁棒性并优于所有比较基线。
conclusion: KDGen-BF框架在多用户波束成形任务中表现出色，通过利用低维RSRP观测值实现了超越传统有限码本的性能，且在噪声环境下表现出高度的鲁棒性。

title: Robust Model Order Selection via Dithered Differential Step-Down Thresholding
authors: Aleksandr Kharin
abstract: This paper studies the problem of model order selection in stationary noise. Single-threshold detection is sensitive to extreme noise excursions, particularly when the detection threshold is lowered to capture weak deterministic components. To augment single-threshold detection, we propose a differential step-down thresholding algorithm. We use a threshold grid in this algorithm. To overcome the threshold grid misalignment error induced by grid evaluation, we utilize randomized grid dithering. Using extreme value theory, we show the clustering of the noise extrema. The stopping rule of the proposed algorithm detects this clustering and stops the algorithm to prevent false alarms. By analytically bounding the threshold grid misalignment error, we prove that our algorithm achieves asymptotic exact order recovery under the 0-1 loss function. Moreover, the proposed algorithm remains robust even if the detection threshold in the original single-threshold algorithm is lowered or extreme noise excursions occur.

zh_title: 通过微抖动差分降阶阈值实现稳健的模型定阶
translation: 本文研究了平稳噪声环境下的模型定阶问题。单阈值检测对极端噪声偏移敏感，特别是当降低检测阈值以捕获微弱确定性成分时。为了增强单阈值检测，我们提出了一种差分降阶阈值算法。我们在该算法中使用了一个阈值网格。为了克服由网格评估引起的阈值网格错位误差，我们利用了随机网格抖动。利用极值理论，我们展示了噪声极值的聚类性。所提算法的停止规则检测这种聚类并停止算法以防止误报。通过对阈值网格错位误差进行解析界定，我们证明了我们的算法在0-1损失函数下实现了渐近精确的阶恢复。此外，即使在原始单阈值算法中的检测阈值降低或发生极端噪声偏移时，所提算法依然保持稳健。
tldr: 提出了一种稳健的模型定阶算法，通过网格抖动和极值理论解决了传统单阈值检测对极端噪声敏感的问题，实现了渐近精确的阶恢复。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地引入了微抖动差分降阶阈值算法，利用极值理论结合网格抖动解决了传统单阈值检测中的网格错位误差和噪声极值敏感问题，理论上证明了渐近精确阶恢复。
motivation: 传统的单阈值检测对极端噪声 excursions（异常波动）非常敏感，特别是在降低检测阈值以捕获微弱确定性成分时表现不佳，因此需要一种更稳健的模型定阶方法。
method: 提出差分降阶阈值算法，采用阈值网格并利用随机网格抖动克服网格错位误差；结合极值理论分析噪声极值的聚类性，并设计停止准则防止误报。
results: 通过分析边界阈值网格的错位误差，证明了该算法在0-1损失函数下实现了渐近精确的阶恢复，且在降低阈值或遇到极端噪声时仍保持稳健。
conclusion: 提出的DSDT算法能够有效克服单阈值检测的局限性，在平稳噪声下实现稳健且渐近精确的模型定阶。

title: From Identification to Authentication for Micro-CSI RF Fingerprinting in OFDM Systems
authors: Matteo Varotto, Stefano Tomasin
abstract: We consider a scenario where a legitimate user (Alice) authenticates itself to an authenticator (Bob) by transmitting orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) pilots, from which the authenticator extracts the Micro-CSI (M-CSI) fingerprint and compares it against a stored reference via a likelihood test (LT)-based test. We introduce a new spoofing attack, where two adversarial devices collude to first jointly estimate the M-CSI fingerprints of Alice and Bob and then construct a forged signal able to break the authentication mechanism with high probability, limited only by noise effects on the estimates. We derive approximate closed-form distributions of the authentication test statistic under both the legitimate and spoofing hypotheses, enabling the derivation of false alarm and misdetection probabilities in closed-form. We then validate our analytical results against M-CSI fingerprints extracted from experimental data. The results reveal that, given sufficient pilot observations or an equivalent noise statistic between Bob and the attackers, the latter can always drive the test statistics to a random classifier, vanishing the security of M-CSI-based authentication.
zh_title: 从OFDM系统中Micro-CSI射频指纹的身份识别到认证
translation: 我们考虑这样一个场景：合法用户（Alice）通过传输正交频分复用（OFDM）导频向认证者（Bob）进行身份验证，认证者从中提取微信道状态信息（Micro-CSI）指纹，并通过基于似然比检验（LT）的测试将其与存储的参考进行比较。我们引入了一种新的欺骗攻击，其中两个对抗设备合谋，首先联合估计Alice和Bob的Micro-CSI指纹，然后构建一个能够以高概率破解认证机制的伪造信号，其限制仅受估计上的噪声影响。我们推导了在合法假设和欺骗假设下认证检验统计量的近似闭式分布，从而能够以闭式推导虚警概率和漏检概率。然后，我们针对从实验数据中提取的Micro-CSI指纹验证了我们的分析结果。结果表明，给定足够的导频观测值或Bob与攻击者之间的等效噪声统计量，后者总是可以使测试统计量驱动至随机分类器，从而使基于Micro-CSI的认证安全性归于零。
tldr: 该论文揭示了OFDM系统中基于Micro-CSI的射频指纹认证机制容易受到一种新型双设备协同欺骗攻击的破坏，从而导致安全性完全失效。
ai_comments: 该论文针对OFDM系统中基于Micro-CSI的射频指纹认证机制，揭示了一种新型协同欺骗攻击的漏洞，并通过理论分析和实验验证了其对系统安全性的致命威胁，具有重要的理论和安全警示意义。
motivation: 评估基于OFDM系统中微信道状态信息（Micro-CSI）射频指纹身份认证机制在新型协同欺骗攻击下的安全性。
method: 引入了一种双设备协同估计与伪造信号构造的新型欺骗攻击模型，推导了合法和欺骗假设下认证检验统计量的近似闭式分布，并通过实验数据对分析结果进行了验证。
results: 推导出了虚警概率和漏检概率的闭式解，实验结果表明，当有足够的导频观测或攻击者与接收机具有等效噪声统计时，攻击者可使测试统计量退化为随机分类器，导致Micro-CSI认证安全性完全失效。
conclusion: 在特定条件下，双设备协同攻击可以使基于Micro-CSI的射频指纹认证系统失效，降级为随机分类器，这表明未来的安全设计需要考虑更高级的抗欺骗策略。

title: Agentic Quantum Deep Reinforcement Learning for RAN Slicing
authors: Tingnan Bao, Medhat Elsayed, Pedro Enrique Iturria-Rivera, Yigit Ozcan, Majid Bavand, Melike Erol-Kantarci
abstract: Radio access network (RAN) slicing enables ultra-reliable low-latency communications (URLLC) and enhanced mobile broadband (eMBB) services to share radio resources, but their requirements create a challenging reliability--throughput tradeoff. URLLC requires low-latency and reliable packet delivery, whereas eMBB targets high sustained throughput. This paper considers downlink URLLC/eMBB RAN slicing and formulates it as a queue-aware long-term eMBB throughput maximization problem subject to URLLC delay-violation, physical resource block (PRB) exclusivity, and slice-budget constraints. To solve this problem, we propose agentic quantum deep reinforcement learning (Agentic-QDRL), a two-time-scale framework that combines agentic slice-level resource control with quantum-enhanced PRB scheduling. At the slow time scale, a perceive--memory--act--reflect (PMAR) controller adapts the resource shares of URLLC and eMBB slices. At the fast time scale, a compact variational quantum circuit (VQC)-based QDRL scheduler performs PRB allocation under the current slice configuration. A feasibility projection and a safety fallback mechanism is further introduced to satisfy scheduling constraints and reduce URLLC deadline violations. Simulation results under different eMBB traffic loads show that Agentic-QDRL improves eMBB throughput, reduces eMBB queue buildup, and maintains URLLC delay reliability compared with classical DRL and heuristic baselines.
zh_title: 面向RAN切片的智能体量子深度强化学习
translation: 无线接入网（RAN）切片使超可靠低时延通信（URLLC）和增强型移动宽带（eMBB）服务能够共享无线资源，但它们的需求带来了一个具有挑战性的可靠性与吞吐量权衡问题。URLLC要求低时延和可靠的数据包传输，而eMBB则专注于持续的高吞吐量。本文考虑下行URLLC/eMBB RAN切片，将其建模为一个队列感知的长期eMBB吞吐量最大化问题，该问题受限于URLLC时延违背、物理资源块（PRB）排他性和切片预算约束。为了解决该问题，我们提出了智能体量子深度强化学习（Agentic-QDRL），这是一个结合了智能体切片级资源控制与量子增强PRB调度的两时间尺度框架。在慢时间尺度上，感知-记忆-行动-反思（PMAR）控制器自适应调整URLLC和eMBB切片的资源份额。在快时间尺度上，基于紧凑变分量子电路（VQC）的QDRL调度器在当前切片配置下执行PRB分配。进一步引入了可行性投影和安全回退机制，以满足调度约束并减少URLLC截止期违背。在不同eMBB业务负载下的仿真结果表明，与经典DRL和启发式基线相比，Agentic-QDRL提高了eMBB吞吐量，减少了eMBB队列堆积，并维持了URLLC时延可靠性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Agentic-QDRL的两时间尺度量子深度强化学习框架，用于解决无线接入网（RAN）中URLLC与eMBB切片的资源分配与可靠性-吞吐量权衡问题。
ai_comments: 该论文巧妙地将量子计算、大模型智能体思想（PMAR控制器）与深度强化学习相结合，解决了RAN切片中复杂的URLLC与eMBB可靠性-吞吐量权衡问题。创新性在于两时间尺度设计以及量子变分电路的应用。
motivation: 无线接入网（RAN）切片中URLLC（超可靠低时延）和eMBB（增强型移动宽带）的共存带来了极具挑战性的可靠性与吞吐量权衡问题，传统的经典方法难以高效解决该复杂长期的约束优化问题。
method: 提出了一种名为Agentic-QDRL的两时间尺度框架。慢时间尺度采用包含感知-记忆-行动-反思（PMAR）控制器的智能体进行资源份额调整；快时间尺度采用基于紧凑变分量子电路（VQC）的QDRL调度器进行PRB分配，并引入了可行性投影和安全回退机制。
results: 仿真结果表明，在不同的eMBB业务负载下，Agentic-QDRL相比经典DRL和启发式基线，能够有效提高eMBB吞吐量，减少eMBB队列堆积，并维持URLLC的时延可靠性。
conclusion: Agentic-QDRL框架有效解决了RAN切片中URLLC与eMBB的冲突，在提升eMBB吞吐量的同时保障了URLLC的时延可靠性，具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Site-specific Channel Modeling Based on Remote-Sensing Maps for 6G Space--Air--Ground Digital Twins
authors: Peijie Liu, Pan Tang, Jianhua Zhang, Lei Tian, Bin Ao, Boyang He, Hao Zheng
abstract: Site-specific channel models are essential for wireless digital twins of 6G space--air--ground communication systems. However, 3D maps are difficult to obtain over wide areas, which limits large-area site-specific channel modeling. To address this issue, this paper proposes a remote-sensing-based augmented ray-tracing channel modeling framework. The framework comprises a deterministic RT branch, a measurement-statistical branch, and an RT augmentation branch. To overcome the difficulty of acquiring large-area 3D maps, the deterministic RT branch reconstructs a 3D RT scene from satellite remote-sensing imagery and calibrates its electromagnetic material parameters using measured path loss. To provide the statistical parameters required for RT augmentation, the measurement-statistical branch establishes the marginal distributions and interparameter dependence models of the channel parameters. Specifically, a wideband UAV channel measurement campaign is conducted at 4.60 GHz, and a proposed multipath estimation method estimates the complex amplitudes, delays, and Doppler shifts of the measured multipath. To bridge the gap between RT predictions and measurements, the RT augmentation branch organizes the RT multipath into LoS, LoS-tail, and NLoS components, generates additional short-delay LoS-tail paths, and reallocates the component and path powers according to the measurement-derived statistics while preserving the total RT received power. The validation results show that the proposed framework reduces the path loss RMSE from 5.45 to 4.35 dB and, relative to calibrated RT, decreases the RMS delay spread and normalized Doppler spread RMSEs by 53.03 and 26.48, respectively. The proposed framework provides a site-specific channel modeling approach for 6G space--air--ground digital-twin studies.
zh_title: 基于遥感地图的6G空天地数字孪生特定地点信道建模
translation: 特定地点的信道模型对于6G空天地通信系统的无线数字孪生至关重要。然而，3D地图在大面积范围内难以获取，这限制了大面积特定地点的信道建模。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于遥感增强的射线追踪信道建模框架。该框架包含一个确定性RT分支、一个测量统计分支和一个RT增强分支。为克服获取大面积3D地图的困难，确定性RT分支从卫星遥感图像中重建3D RT场景，并使用测量的路径损耗校准其电磁材料参数。为了提供RT增强所需的统计参数，测量统计分支建立了信道参数的边缘分布和参数间依赖模型。具体而言，在4.60 GHz下开展了宽带无人机信道测量活动，并利用提出的多径估计方法估计了测量多径的复幅度、时延和多普勒频移。为了弥合RT预测与测量之间的差距，RT增强分支将RT多径组织为视距（LoS）、LoS尾部和非视距（NLoS）分量，根据测量推导的统计数据生成额外的短时延LoS尾部路径，并重新分配分量和路径功率，同时保持总RT接收功率不变。验证结果表明，所提出的框架将路径损耗RMSE从5.45 dB降低至4.35 dB，并且相对于校准后的RT，均方根时延扩展和归一化多普勒扩展的RMSE分别降低了53.03和26.48。所提出的框架为6G空天地数字孪生研究提供了一种特定地点的信道建模方法。
tldr: 提出了一种基于遥感影像的增强射线追踪信道建模框架，解决了6G空天地数字孪生中大范围3D地图缺失的问题，显著提高了信道预测精度。
ai_comments: 该论文针对6G空天地一体化数字孪生中大范围三坐标地图难以获取的痛点，创新性地提出了一种结合卫星遥感影像与射线追踪（RT）的数据增强信道建模框架，通过测量统计与RT增强分支的结合显著提升了信道预测的精度。
motivation: 6G空天地通信系统数字孪生需要特定地点的信道模型，但大范围3D地图获取困难，限制了大面积特定地点信道建模的发展。
method: 提出一个包含确定性RT分支、测量统计分支和RT增强分支的遥感增强射线追踪信道建模框架；利用卫星遥感影像重建3D RT场景，并通过实测路径损耗校准电磁材料参数；通过UAV信道测量获取统计参数；通过RT增强分支组织并重新分配多径功率。
results: 验证结果表明，该框架将路径损耗RMSE从5.45 dB降低到4.35 dB，相较于校准后的RT，均方根时延扩展和归一化多普勒扩展的RMSE分别减少了53.03和26.48。
conclusion: 本文提出的基于遥感地图的增强型射线追踪信道建模框架能够有效克服大范围3D地图缺失的困难，显著提高6G空天地通信系统数字孪生中路径损耗和多径参数的预测精度。

title: Weakly Supervised Tabla Stroke Transcription via an Adaptive Dynamic Rhythm Language Model (ADRM)
authors: Rahul Bapusaheb Kodag, Vipul Arora
abstract: Tabla Stroke Transcription (TST) is central to the analysis of rhythmic structure in Hindustani music, yet it remains challenging due to complex and dynamic rhythmic organization and the scarcity of strongly annotated data. Existing approaches largely rely on fully supervised learning with onset-level annotations, which are costly and impractical at scale. This work addresses TST in a weakly supervised setting, using only symbolic stroke sequences without temporal alignment of onsets. We propose a framework that combines a Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC)-based acoustic model with a sequence-level rhythmic language model for rescoring, similar to that used in automatic speech recognition. The acoustic model produces a decoding lattice, which is refined using an Adaptive Dynamic Rhythm Language Model (ADRM) that combines $t\bar{a}la$-conditioned symbolic rhythmic regularities with local stroke dynamics. Moreover, we release a new performance-recorded tabla dataset, named \emph{Tabla Improvisation Dataset}, along with a complementary synthetic dataset for sequence-level weakly supervised TST. Experiments demonstrate consistent and substantial reductions in stroke error rates with ADRM compared to those with acoustic-only decoding, confirming the benefit of incorporating symbolic rhythmic regularities during lattice rescoring for accurate transcription.
zh_title: 基于自适应动态节奏语言模型（ADRM）的弱监督塔布拉鼓击转录
translation: 塔布拉鼓击转录（TST）是分析印度斯坦音乐节奏结构的核心，但由于复杂且动态的节奏组织以及强标注数据的稀缺，它依然具有挑战性。现有方法主要依赖需要起始时间级别标注的全监督学习，这在规模化应用中成本高昂且不切实际。本工作在弱监督设置下研究TST，仅使用符号鼓击序列而无需起始时间的时间对齐。我们提出了一个框架，将基于连接主义时间分类（CTC）的声学模型与用于重打分的序列级节奏语言模型相结合（类似于自动语音识别中使用的技术）。声学模型产生一个解码格，通过自适应动态节奏语言模型（ADRM）对其进行精炼，该模型结合了$t\bar{a}la$（塔尔）条件的符号节奏规律与局部鼓击动态。此外，我们发布了一个名为“Tabla Improvisation Dataset”的全新演奏录音塔布拉数据集，以及一个用于序列级弱监督TST的互补合成数据集。实验表明，与仅使用声学解码相比，使用ADRM可以持续且大幅地降低鼓击错误率，证实了在格子重打分过程中引入符号节奏规律以实现准确转录的优势。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于自适应动态节奏语言模型（ADRM）的弱监督塔布拉鼓击转录方法，无需耗时的起始时间标注即可大幅降低转录错误率。
ai_comments: 该论文创新性地将弱监督学习与自适应动态节奏语言模型（ADRM）应用于塔布拉鼓击转录（TST），无需细粒度的起始时间对齐标注即可实现准确转录，并开源了新的数据集，对印度斯坦音乐计算音乐学的发展具有重要推动作用。
motivation: 由于复杂的动态节奏组织以及强标注数据稀缺，传统的全监督塔布拉鼓击转录（TST）方法成本高昂且难以扩展，因此需要研究仅依赖符号鼓击序列、无需起始时间对齐的弱监督转录方法。
method: 提出了一种结合CTC声学模型与序列级节奏语言模型（ADRM）的弱监督框架，利用声学模型生成解码格（lattice），并使用结合了tāla条件化符号节奏规律与局部鼓击动态的ADRM进行重打分。
results: 实验表明，相比于纯声学解码，使用ADRM能够一致且大幅度地降低鼓击错误率，从而证实了在格子重打分中整合符号节奏规律的优势。
conclusion: 通过结合基于CTC的声学模型与自适应动态节奏语言模型（ADRM），弱监督塔布拉鼓击转录在性能上取得了显著提升，验证了在网格重打分中引入符号节奏规律的有效性。

title: Foundation Models for Wireless Localization: Pretraining, Adaptation, and Utilization
authors: Guangjin Pan, Jiajia Guo, Zheng Xing, Hui Chen, Chao-Kai Wen, Shi Jin, Henk Wymeersch
abstract: Accurate wireless localization is a key enabler for 6G networks, yet remains challenging under diverse and rapidly changing propagation conditions. Model-based methods degrade when multipath channels are non-resolvable and model mismatches occur, while supervised deep learning demands large labeled datasets and generalizes poorly to new deployments. Inspired by foundation models (FMs) in language and vision, this article presents a unified framework for FM-based wireless localization that learns transferable channel representations from large-scale unlabeled channel state information and adapts to new environments with minimal or even no supervision. We review the fundamentals of FMs, compare the FM paradigm with existing localization approaches, and introduce a three-stage framework spanning large-scale pretraining, localization-oriented fine-tuning, and context-augmented inference, together with the location-aware applications it enables. Ray-tracing-based case studies show improved positioning accuracy and cross-environment generalization. Finally, we present an outlook on key research directions toward AI-native networks for wireless localization.
comment: 4 pages, 1 table. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
zh_title: 面向无线定位的基础模型：预训练、适应与利用
translation: 精确的无线定位是6G网络的关键赋能技术，但在多样且快速变化的传播条件下仍然具有挑战性。传统的基于模型的方法在多径信道无法分辨且出现模型失配时性能会下降，而有监督的深度学习则需要大量标注数据集，并且对新部署环境的泛化能力较差。受自然语言和视觉领域基础模型（FMs）的启发，本文提出了一个用于FM无线定位的统一框架，它通过从大规模未标注的信道状态信息中学习可迁移的信道表征，并以极少甚至无需监督的方式适应新环境。我们回顾了FM的基础知识，将FM范式与现有定位方法进行了比较，并介绍了一个包含大规模预训练、面向定位的微调和上下文增强推理的三阶段框架，以及它所支持的位置感知应用。基于射线追踪的案例研究表明，该方法提高了定位精度和跨环境泛化能力。最后，我们对迈向面向无线定位的AI原生网络的关键研究方向进行了展望。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型的无线定位三阶段统一框架，通过大规模预训练与自适应机制，克服了传统方法在复杂环境下的局限性，显著提升了定位精度与泛化能力。
ai_comments: 该论文将大模型（Foundation Models）范式引入无线定位领域，通过大规模无监督信道状态信息预训练及迁移适应，有效解决了传统基于模型方法和监督深度学习在复杂多变环境下泛化能力差、依赖大量标注数据的痛点，为6G AI原生网络开辟了新途径。
motivation: 传统的基于模型的定位方法在多径信道下性能退化，而有监督深度学习需要大量标注数据且跨环境泛化能力差，亟需引入大模型（Foundation Models）来实现可迁移的信道表征与少样本/无监督适应。
method: 提出包含大规模预训练、面向定位的微调以及上下文增强推理的三阶段框架，并利用射线追踪（Ray-tracing）技术进行案例研究。
results: 射线追踪案例研究表明，该框架能够显著提高定位精度并增强跨环境泛化能力。
conclusion: 基于大模型的无线 localization 框架展现出优异的定位精度和跨环境泛化能力，是迈向AI原生6G网络的重要方向。

title: Leveraging Bayesian Optimization for Array Shape Self-Calibration in Underwater DoA Estimation
authors: Xin Gui, Tianang Li, Changjia Wang, Bowen Han, Yunchuan Zhang, Zhengying Li
abstract: Flexible sensing arrays are commonly used in underwater acoustic networks, but suppressed by unpredictable geometric deformations. Existing array shape self-calibration methods often estimate individual element positions separately, leading to a high dimensional optimization problem over long arrays. To address this problem, this paper proposes a Bayesian Optimization-assisted Geometry Estimation (BOGE) strategy operating with a hierarchical optimization process and a physics-informed parametric model for array geometry correction. BOGE formulates array shape self-calibration as an optimization problem, where candidate geometries are evaluated by the noise subspace residual. We perform Bayesian optimization to configure the physics-informed parametric model and then refine the selected geometry through numerical optimization. Empirical results show that BOGE achieves lower mean geometric root mean square error (RMSE) than the benchmark methods across a wide range of noise levels. On the public SWellEx-96 dataset, BOGE achieves a geometric RMSE of $0.659$ meters at $166$ Hz. A lake trial further shows that BOGE provides fixed source localization and moving target tracking performance comparable to the comparison methods.
comment: 13 pages, 12 figures, submitted to an IEEE journal
zh_title: 利用贝叶斯优化实现水下DOA估计中的阵列形状自校准
translation: 柔性传感阵列常用于水下声学网络，但受不可预测的几何变形所抑制。现有的阵列形状自校准方法通常分别估计各个阵元的位置，导致长阵列的高维优化问题。为解决此问题，本文提出了一种贝叶斯优化辅助几何估计（BOGE）策略，该策略采用分层优化过程和用于阵列几何校准的物理启发参数模型。BOGE将阵列形状自校准表述为一个优化问题，其中候选几何形状通过噪声子空间残差进行评估。我们执行贝叶斯优化来配置物理启发的参数模型，然后通过数值优化精炼所选的几何形状。实证结果表明，在广泛的噪声水平下，BOGE实现了比基准方法更低的平均几何均方根误差（RMSE）。在公共的SWellEx-96数据集上，BOGE在166 Hz时实现了0.659米的几何RMSE。湖试进一步表明，BOGE提供了与对比方法相当的固定源定位和运动目标跟踪性能。
tldr: 提出了一种利用贝异斯优化和物理启发参数模型进行水下阵列形状自校准的BOGE策略，有效解决了柔性阵列的高维几何优化难题并提高了DOA估计精度。
ai_comments: 该论文提出了一种结合物理启发参数模型与贝叶斯优化的水下阵列形状自校准策略，有效降低了高维优化的复杂度，在水下声学目标测向中具有很高的实用价值和创新性。
motivation: 柔性传感阵列在水下声学网络中广泛应用，但常受不可预测的几何变形影响；现有的自校准方法通常单独估计各个阵元位置，导致长阵列的高维优化问题变得十分棘手。
method: 提出基于贝叶斯优化的几何估计（BOGE）策略，采用分层优化过程和物理启发的参数模型，利用噪声子空间残差评估候选几何形状，结合贝叶斯优化与数值优化进行阵列几何校准。
results: 实验结果表明，在各种噪声水平下，BOGE均能实现比基准方法更低的平均几何均方根误差（RMSE）；在SWellEx-96数据集上，166 Hz时的几何RMSE达到0.659米；湖试表明其固定源定位和运动目标跟踪性能与对比方法相当。
conclusion: BOGE策略能够有效解决水下柔性阵列由于几何变形带来的测向误差问题，在模拟、公开数据集和湖试中均表现出优异的性能。

title: Compressed Single-Tone Frequency Estimation With Unknown Complex Gain: Singular Rates and Global Identifiability
authors: Armon Rasooli
abstract: Fixed linear compression can preserve local Fisher information for a sinusoid yet destroy global frequency identification, while a dark response can make local estimation nonregular. We study both failures for a single complex tone observed through a fixed complex-linear sketch with unknown nonzero complex gain and pre-sketch white Gaussian noise. Near an isolated analytic dark frequency, we separate radial signal vanishing from optimized projective contact between the two signed frequency branches. When the gain magnitude is constrained to a fixed nondegenerate interval, finite contact is equivalent to local quotient identifiability and minimax consistency. The sharp mean-square-error rate is determined by the sum of the radial and contact orders; infinite contact produces exact local aliases. Globally, we formulate a worst-frequency efficientinformation objective on whitened row spaces. We solve it exactly for every even output rank, prove uniqueness and quantitative rigidity of the symmetric-edge projector, and solve the evenaperture co-rank-one case. The rank-two optimum is aliased, and a winding obstruction gives a positive lower bound on the information price of global identification. From three outputs onward, sketches that are globally identifying with an immersive projective response are open and dense and have zero price at the level of suprema; for every even rank of at least four, the exact optimizer has this property. Thus local information preservation, singular recoverability, and global identifiability obey distinct compression laws within one estimation model.
zh_title: 具有未知复增益的压缩单音频率估计：奇异率与全局可辨识性
translation: 固定线性压缩可以保留正弦波的局部Fisher信息，但会破坏全局频率辨识，而暗响应则会使局部估计不规则。我们研究了通过固定复线性草图、具有未知非零复增益以及预草图高斯白噪声观测到的单个复音的这两种失效情况。在孤立的解析暗频率附近，我们将径向信号消失与两个带符号频率分支之间优化的投影接触分离开来。当增益幅度受限于一个固定的非退化区间时，有限接触等价于局部商可辨识性和极小imax一致性。尖锐的均方误差率由径向阶数和接触阶数之和决定；无限接触会产生精确的局部别名。从全局来看，我们在白化行空间上构建了一个最劣频率有效信息目标。我们精确求解了每一个偶数输出秩，证明了对称边缘投影矩阵的唯一性和定量刚性，并求解了偶孔径余秩一的情况。秩二最优解是混叠的，缠绕阻碍为全局辨识的信息代价提供了正下限。从三个输出开始，具有沉浸式投影响应的全局可辨识草图是开且稠密的，并且在上确界水平上代价为零；对于至少为四的每个偶数秩，精确的优化器具有此属性。因此，局部信息保持、奇异可恢复性和全局可辨识性在一个估计模型中服从不同的压缩规律。
tldr: 论文研究了压缩单音频率估计中未知复增益下的奇异率与全局可辨识性，揭示了局部与全局信息压缩的本质差异。
ai_comments: 该论文深入探讨了压缩单音频率估计中的局部Fisher信息保持、全局可辨识性以及奇异恢复率问题，数学推导严谨，揭示了局部与全局压缩规律的本质区别。
motivation: 固定线性压缩可以保留正弦波的局部Fisher信息，但会破坏全局频率辨识，且暗响应会导致局部估计不规则。为了研究这两种失效情况及其背后的数学规律，论文展开了本项研究。
method: 通过研究固定复线性草图、未知复增益及加性高斯白噪声下的单复音观测，分析局部Fisher信息、渐近均方误差率及基于白化行空间的全局最劣频率有效信息目标。
results: 确定了局部均方误差率由径向阶数与接触阶数之和决定；证明了全局最优设计及对称边缘投影矩阵的唯一性与定量刚性；发现从三个输出开始，具有沉浸式投影响应的全局可辨识草图在 suprema 级别具有零代价。
conclusion: 论文证明了局部信息保持、奇异可恢复性和全局可辨识性在单一估计模型中遵循截然不同的压缩规律。

title: Event-Inference Reliability for Physical AI over Wireless Networks
authors: Anup Mishra, Petar Popovski
abstract: Wireless-enabled physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) systems call for a shift from reliable data delivery to reliable inference of physical events. The relevant question is not only whether packets arrive, but whether the set of cues available at the decision node, i.e., the evidence, is sufficiently timely and informative to support reliable inference about the event. Accordingly, this paper develops a framework in which event-inference reliability (EIR) is determined jointly by cue informativeness, cue availability, and temporal admissibility. The latter is determined by the downstream task requirement and represented through the usefulness horizon. We define event-inference error ratio (EIER) as the normalised residual event uncertainty after incorporating admitted cues, and EIR as the corresponding normalised uncertainty reduction, both conditioned on decision-node context. We further distinguish the evidence-limited Bayes benchmark from operational performance of a particular inference engine and derive an entropy-based lower bound on the minimum achievable event error from the same decision-node information. The framework then enables an event-aware wireless design interface for cue prioritisation, cue-reliability allocation, and event-inference coverage characterisation. A multiclass indoor activity-inference study combining empirical cue likelihoods with wireless delivery instantiates the framework and demonstrates how it characterises EIR under finite usefulness horizons.
zh_title: 无线网络中物理AI的事件推理可靠性
translation: 无线赋能的物理人工智能（physical AI）系统要求从可靠的数据传输转变为物理事件的可靠推理。相关的问题不仅在于数据包是否到达，还在于决策节点上可用的一组线索（即证据）是否足够及时和具有信息量，以支持对事件的可靠推断。因此，本文开发了一个框架，其中事件推理可靠性（EIR）由线索信息量、线索可用性和时间容许性共同决定。后者由下游任务需求决定，并通过有用性视界来表示。我们将事件推理错误率（EIER）定义为纳入被接纳线索后归一化的剩余事件不确定性，将EIR定义为对应的归一化不确定性减少量，两者均以决策节点上下文为条件。我们进一步区分了证据受限的贝叶斯基准与特定推理引擎的操作性能，并从相同的决策节点信息中推导了最小可实现事件误差的基于熵的下界。然后，该框架支持用于线索优先级排序、线索可靠性分配和事件推理覆盖特征分析的事件感知无线设计接口。结合经验线索似然与无线传输的多类室内活动推理研究实例化了该框架，并展示了它如何在有限有用性视界下表征EIR。
tldr: 本文提出了一种面向物理AI无线网络的事件推理可靠性（EIR）分析与设计框架，通过联合考虑线索信息量、可用性和时效性来优化无线网络资源分配和任务性能。
ai_comments: 该论文针对物理人工智能（Physical AI）系统，提出了从传统“可靠数据传输”转向“可靠事件推理”的新范式，并通过引入事件推理可靠性（EIR）、证据受限贝叶斯基准及熵基下界，为无线网络资源分配和cue优先排序提供了事件感知的理论设计接口。
motivation: 无线赋能的物理人工智能（Physical AI）系统需要从关注可靠的数据传输转变到关注物理事件的可靠推理，传统的只看数据包是否到达的指标已无法满足决策节点对及时且具信息量证据的需求。
method: 开发了一个事件推理可靠性（EIR）评估框架，将其由线索信息量、可用性和时间容许性（有用性视界）共同决定；定义了事件推理错误率（EIER）和EIR；推导了基于熵的事件最小误差下界，并提出了事件感知的无线设计接口。
results: 多类室内活动推理研究的算例结合表明，该框架能够有效刻画在有限有用性视界下的事件推理可靠性（EIR），实现线索优先级排序与可靠性分配。
conclusion: 通过建立结合线索信息量、可用性和时间容许性的事件推理可靠性（EIR）分析框架，论文成功桥接了无线网络传输与物理AI下游任务需求，为面向任务的无线系统设计奠定了理论基础。

title: Towards Balanced Spectral Reconstruction: Spectrally Adaptive Loss for Streaming Speech Enhancement
authors: Haixin Zhao, Nilesh Madhu
abstract: This paper proposes two spectrally weighted STFT loss functions for lightweight streaming speech enhancement, addressing the magnitude over-attenuation in mid-to-high frequency regions caused by the magnitude-phase compensation effect. The proposed sigmoid-weighted loss applies a smooth frequency-dependent modulation to the phase-aware contribution, while the signal-dependent spectrally adaptive loss further conditions the modulation on the ground-truth log-magnitude spectrogram. To evaluate the proposed objectives, we additionally design HyST-Net, a lightweight and competitive backbone with hybrid MHA-GRU spectral-temporal modelling for low-latency streaming scenarios. Experimental results exhibit consistent improvements in high-frequency spectral reconstruction for both losses. The spectrally adaptive loss further enhances the mid-frequency region, resulting in a more balanced spectral reconstruction across the full frequency range.

title: Energy Efficiency in Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC)-Enabled Communications
authors: Ahmed Magbool, Marco Di Renzo
abstract: Microwave linear analog computers (MiLACs) have emerged as a promising architecture for energy-efficient wireless communications by shifting signal processing from the digital to the analog domain using tunable impedance networks. Several MiLAC architectures have recently been proposed, including the single-layer MiLAC (SLM), two-layer MiLAC (TLM), and hybrid digital-MiLAC (HDM). In this paper, we investigate the energy efficiency (EE) of these architectures. Specifically, we formulate EE maximization problems for the SLM, TLM, and HDM architectures under transmit power, user rate, and architecture-specific constraints, and develop a dimensionality reduction technique with successive convex approximation (SCA)-based algorithms to efficiently solve the resulting non-convex problems. We further derive a computationally efficient solution for EE maximization based on a search over only $(K+1)$ closed-form candidate solutions, where $K$ is the number of users, and analyze the asymptotic EE in the large-antenna regime under negligible quantization noise. Our analysis shows that the EE of the SLM, TLM, and HDM architectures scales as $\ln(N)/N^2$, whereas conventional digital beamforming (DBF) scales as $\ln(N)/N$, where $N$ denotes the number of transmit antennas. Despite these different scaling laws, the faster EE decay of MiLAC-based architectures becomes relevant only at very large antenna dimensions, typically involving thousands of antennas, while they maintain superior EE over practically relevant finite antenna regimes. Finally, we derive an approximation of the number of antennas required to achieve the maximum EE for each architecture and the corresponding EE. Simulation results show that, over practically relevant antenna regimes, MiLAC-based architectures achieve substantially higher EE than conventional fully digital and hybrid analog-digital beamforming.

zh_title: 启用微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）通信的能效研究
translation: 微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）通过利用可调谐阻抗网络将信号处理从数字域转移到模拟域，已成为实现能效无线通信的一种有前景的架构。最近提出了几种MiLAC架构，包括单层MiLAC（SLM）、双层MiLAC（TLM）和混合数字-MiLAC（HDM）。在本文中，我们研究了这些架构的能效（EE）。具体而言，我们在发射功率、用户速率和架构特定约束下，分别构建了SLM、TLM和HDM架构的能效最大化问题，并开发了一种降维技术以及基于连续凸近似（SCA）的算法来有效求解所得的非凸问题。我们进一步基于对仅 $(K+1)$ 个闭式候选解的搜索，推导了一种用于能效最大化的计算高效解（其中 $K$ 是用户数），并分析了在可忽略量化噪声下大天线区间的渐近能效。我们的分析表明，SLM、TLM和HDM架构的能效随发射天线数量 $N$ 的缩放关系为 $\ln(N)/N^2$，而传统数字波束成形（DBF）的缩放关系为 $\ln(N)/N$。尽管存在这些不同的缩放规律，MiLAC基架构更快的能效衰减仅在非常大的天线维度（通常涉及数千根天线）时才相关，而在实际相关的有限天线区间内它们保持了优越的能效。最后，我们推导了实现每种架构最大能效所需天线数量的近似值及对应的能效。仿真结果表明，在实际相关的天线区间内，基于MiLAC的架构实现了比传统全数字和混合模拟-数字波束成形更高的能效。
tldr: 本文研究了微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）在无线通信中的能效，证明MiLAC在实际天线规模下的能效显著优于传统数字波束成形技术。
ai_comments: 该论文深入研究了微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）在无线通信中的能效表现，通过理论推导与仿真，揭示了MiLAC在实际天线规模下优于传统数字波束成形的能效优势，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。
motivation: 微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）作为一种通过可调阻抗网络将信号处理从数字域转移到模拟域的节能无线通信新架构，其在不同架构下的能效表现及优化策略尚待系统研究。
method: 针对SLM、TLM和HDM架构分别构建了能效最大化问题，开发了降维技术结合基于连续凸近似（SCA）的算法来求解非凸问题；推导了基于 $(K+1)$ 个闭式候选解搜索的计算高效解；并分析了大天线情况下的渐近能效。
results: 理论分析表明，MiLAC架构的能效随天线数量 $N$ 的缩放规律为 $\ln(N)/N^2$，而传统数字波束成形为 $\ln(N)/N$。尽管如此，MiLAC在实际相关天线规模下仍保持更高的能效，仿真结果验证了其相较于传统方法的显著能效提升。
conclusion: 在实际相关的天线规模下，基于MiLAC的架构（SLM、TLM、HDM）能效显著优于传统数字波束成形和混合模拟-数字波束成形。尽管在超大规模天线时其能效衰减速度快于传统方法，但MiLAC在中小规模天线应用中表现出极佳的能效优势。

title: An Optical Pathway to Movable Rydberg Atomic Quantum Receivers
authors: Qihao Peng, Qu Luo, Lixia Xiao, De Mi, Neng Ye, Cunhua Pan, Pei Xiao, Cheng-Xiang Wang, Jiangzhou Wang
abstract: This paper develops an optically movable Rydberg atomic quantum receiver (RAQR), in which the probe and coupling beams are steered within each vapor cell to dynamically reconfigure the effective radio-frequency (RF) sensing position without mechanical actuation. A closed-form equivalent baseband model is derived by separating the atomic transduction coefficient, optical steering phase, and cell-center array response into distinct factors and the accuracy of the resulting model is validated against numerical solutions of the Lindblad master equation. Based on the derived model, we reveal two complementary channel-shaping mechanisms, including intrinsic beam-pattern shaping through RF-to-optical transduction and per-cell phase control enabled by optical displacement. To further exploit these capabilities, a non-convex sum-rate maximization problem is formulated over the optical positions and local oscillator design and solved via an alternating optimization framework with analytical gradients. Simulation results validate the derived model and demonstrate substantial performance gains enabled by optical movability, highlighting its potential as a programmable receiver architecture for future wireless networks.
zh_title: 可移动里德堡原子量子接收器的光学路径
translation: 本文开发了一种光学可移动的里德堡原子量子接收器（RAQR），其中探测光束和耦合光束在每个气室内部进行操纵，以动态重新配置有效的射频（RF）传感位置，而无需机械驱动。通过将原子转换系数、光学转向相位和气室中心阵列响应分离为不同的因子，推导出了一个封闭形式的等效基带模型，并且该模型的准确性通过与林德布拉德主方程数值解的对比得到了验证。基于导出的模型，我们揭示了两种互补的信道塑造机制，包括通过射频到光学转换的固有波束图塑造和通过光学位移实现的每个气室相位控制。为了进一步利用这些功能，针对光学位置和本地振荡器设计构建了一个非凸和速率最大化问题，并通过带有解析梯度的交替优化框架进行求解。仿真结果验证了所导出的模型，并展示了由光学可移动性带来的巨大性能增益，突显了其作为未来无线网络可编程接收器架构的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出了一种无需机械驱动的光学可移动里德堡原子量子接收器，通过光束转向实现射频传感位置的动态重构，并证明了其在未来无线网络中的性能优势。
ai_comments: 本文提出了一种光学可移动的里德堡原子量子接收器，通过光束转向实现射频传感位置的动态重构，无需机械驱动。创新点在于通过闭合形式的等效基带模型和信道塑造机制，提升了未来无线网络的性能，具有重要的应用前景。
motivation: 传统的里德堡原子量子接收器缺乏灵活的动态重构能力，且机械驱动存在局限性，因此需要开发一种无需机械驱动、能够动态重构射频传感位置的光学可移动里德堡原子量子接收器。
method: 通过分离原子转换系数、光学转向相位和蜂窝中心阵列响应，推导了闭合形式的等效基带模型；提出了一种基于交替优化框架的非凸和速率最大化问题求解方法。
results: 仿真结果验证了所推导模型的准确性，并展示了光学可移动性所带来的显著性能增益，凸显其作为未来无线网络可编程接收器架构的潜力。
conclusion: 该工作验证了光学可移动里德堡原子量子接收器的可行性，通过闭合形式模型和交替优化框架证明了其在未来无线网络中的巨大潜力与性能增益。

title: Likelihood-Constrained Acoustic Reranking for Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation in LLM-Based ASR
authors: Jiasheng Kuang, Linru Zheng, Hongjin Song, Zhaoqi Cui, Song Li
abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems achieve strong performance on conventional speech data by leveraging powerful linguistic priors and multilingual capabilities. However, under challenging conditions, these priors can override acoustic evidence, resulting in unintended translation, instruction execution, repetition, or catastrophic deletion. We propose Likelihood-Constrained Acoustic Reranking (LCAR), a training-free decoding method that improves acoustic grounding while preserving support from the base model. At each decoding step, LCAR first retains tokens whose base-model likelihood falls within a margin of the greedy token, then reranks them using an acoustic compatibility score computed from attention-pooled audio embeddings and the existing LM head. By restricting acoustic intervention to plausible, model-supported alternatives, LCAR requires no additional training, external detector, reference transcript, or auxiliary model at inference. We evaluate LCAR on four LLM-based ASR systems using human-audited TTS and open-source speech challenge suites. At $δ=0.60$, LCAR removes 38.8--57.1\% of detector-identified hallucination failures while largely maintaining WER/CER on standard open-source test sets.

title: Doppler Effect in High-Mobility Free Space Optical Links with Multicarrier Intensity Modulation
authors: Mahmudul Hasan Abid, Mohammad Ali Khalighi, Majid Safari
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the impact of Doppler-induced time scaling in intensity-modulation/direct-detection (IM/DD) multicarrier free-space optical links subject to high mobility. Modeling the Doppler effect as a single-sideband frequency shift applied to the analytic signal waveform, we show that it produces a baseband-equivalent phase rotation, resulting in a common-phase error (CPE), in addition to Dirichlet-kernel inter-carrier interference (ICI), even though the optical carrier phase is removed through photo-detection. The numerical results based on DC-biased optical orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (DCO-OFDM), show that at small Doppler shifts, the CPE component dominates and can be effectively compensated through pilot-aided phase tracking, while the induced ICI remains rather negligible. At larger Doppler shifts, however, ICI becomes dominant and results in a bit-error-rate floor, highlighting the need for both CPE tracking and ICI mitigation. This is particularly relevant for optical links with small subcarrier spacing and large Doppler shifts, such as those in low-Earth-orbit satellite-to-ground and inter-satellite transmission scenarios.

title: Measurement of Liquid Water Content in Snow from Density-Insensitive Microwave Attenuation
authors: Marco Niederberger, Sebastian Droz, Shaarujan Kamalanathan, Michel A. Nyffenegger, Albert Loichinger, Hans-Dieter Lang
abstract: A measurement principle for determining liquid water content (LWC) in snow is presented that does not require a priori knowledge or separate measurement of snow density. LWC affects the imaginary part of the effective permittivity of snow, which is linked to microwave attenuation along a microstrip transmission line embedded in the snowpack, independent of snow density. By analyzing the attenuation over a range of microwave frequencies, the corresponding LWC can be inferred. Full-wave simulations indicate a sensitivity of approximately 2 dB per % LWC,while experimental results confirm the insensitivity to snow density, highlighting the potential for remote snow characterization.

title: Explainable deformable matched filtering reveals measurable departures from classical receiver theory in optical wireless communications
authors: Paul Anthony Haigh
abstract:
Matched filtering is a central result of communication theory, providing the optimal linear receiver when the received waveform satisfies specific assumptions. Practical communication systems rarely satisfy these assumptions, yet learned receivers that outperform the classical matched filter provide little insight into what those improvements reveal about the limitations of the underlying theory.
  Here we introduce an explainable deformable matched-filter framework in which machine learning is constrained to learn a low-dimensional deformation of the classical matched filter rather than replacing it. Because every learned correction is defined relative to the theoretical matched-filter solution, the deformation becomes a measurable representation of receiver mismatch rather than an unconstrained optimisation. The communication waveform remains processed entirely by the matched filter, while a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network predicts only the deformation from physically interpretable receiver-state descriptors.
  Using an optical wireless communication testbed spanning ten signalling formats, four impairment classes and 1,600 conditions, we show that learned deformations improve receiver performance, yielding a median relative error-vector-magnitude reduction of 18.1%, while revealing departures from classical matched-filter optimality. Different signalling families occupy distinct deformation regimes, spectral analysis identifies the physical mechanisms underlying receiver mismatch, and latent receiver-state organisation demonstrates that these departures are structured rather than arbitrary.

title: Channel Gains to Captions: Task-Unified Multi-Level RF Sensing with Vision-Language Models
authors: Tianyu Hu, Zhiren Gong, Haowei Cui, Shuai Wang, Samson Lasaulce, Lingxiang Li, Wassim Hamidouche, Zhi Chen, Merouane Debbah
abstract: This letter investigates a task-unified multi-level radio-frequency (RF) sensing framework driven by vision-language models (VLMs). Existing RF sensing methods rely on task-specific designs and provide only partial environmental information, limiting their ability to handle emerging 6G applications. To address this, we propose a generative formulation for RF sensing, where millimeter-wave (mmWave)/terahertz (THz) channel gains are mapped to captions describing multi-level environmental semantics. The framework solves this problem through a complementary design for RF-environment semantic bridging, where a VLM is fine-tuned to leverage its multimodal representations and prompt-conditioned semantic generation capabilities. Hence, different sensing tasks are specified through textual prompts, enabling the framework to handle diverse tasks in a unified manner. For fine-tuning, we introduce prompt-routed low-rank adaptation (LoRA) experts to achieve level-aware adaptation. Simulation results show that, compared with baselines, our framework achieves superior performance with a broader semantic scope, and enables task-unified sensing beyond predefined tasks. Under an unseen sensing requirement, it achieves an average F1-score improvement of 0.17 over the most competitive variant.

title: Semantic-Aware Sub-Band Allocation for Terahertz Communications
authors: Fatima Ismail, Hadi Sarieddeen, Jihad Fahs
abstract: This paper studies semantic-aware sub-band al- location for terahertz (THz) communication systems, where frequency-selective molecular absorption creates highly non- uniform sub-band qualities. Unlike conventional formulations, semantic fidelity depends nonlinearly on the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and is also sentence-specific, leading to a non-separable assignment problem that is generally not solvable using simple ordering-based policies. To address this, we use a sentence-BERT (SBERT)-based surrogate model that predicts semantic fidelity from the sentence embedding and sub-band SNR. We propose an importance-aware scheduler that assigns sentences to sub- bands based on their semantic contribution using an oracle utility function that captures importance-weighted semantic similarity across sentence-sub-band pairs. A neural scheduler is then trained through imitation learning to approximate the oracle policy at more than 200x lower runtime than full DeepSC- based oracle evaluation. Integrated with a deep-learning-enabled semantic communication (DeepSC) system, the proposed method consistently outperforms all benchmark schemes and approaches oracle-level performance under realistic THz channel conditions.

title: Intrinsic Scatterer Representation for Forward Scattering Modeling of Complex Radar Targets
authors: Ziyu Yue, Feng Xu
abstract: Forward modeling of scattering centers of radar targets is critical for advanced information retrieval of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images. Existing forward modeling approaches rely on meshing the target and computing scattering via ray-tracing techniques, which not only incur high computational cost but also discard the semantic information of target geometry, thereby limiting the interpretability of SAR imagery. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel forward scattering modeling framework that directly constructs stable, compact, and physically meaningful scatterers from target geometry. This formulation decouples target representation from specific observation configurations, enabling an intrinsic scatterer description across varying viewing angles. Specifically, an improved Random Sample Consensus (RANSAC) scheme is first developed to robustly extract planes, cylinders, and spheres from target point clouds, yielding single-bounce scatterers. Potential multiple-bounce scatterers are then automatically detected by analyzing inter-primitive relations, and further refined through geometric clipping and parameter alignment to produce unique scattering representations compatible with canonical scattering center models. Finally, radar responses and SAR images can be generated under arbitrary observation configurations based on the constructed scatterers. The proposed method is validated through extensive experiments, including comparisons with electromagnetic simulations and measured data. The results show that it can accurately characterize the scattering behaviors of complex targets, providing an efficient, interpretable, and reliable solution for SAR image modeling and understanding.

title: SCI-D$^2$NN: An Optimization Framework for OAM-Multiplexed FSO Communications
authors: Rui Deng, Renzhi Yuan, Xinyi Chu, Siming Wang, Chengzhi Liu, Zehao He, Haifeng Yao, Mugen Peng
abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) multiplexing can increase the capacity of free-space optical (FSO) communications, but its detection performance is strongly affected by impairments such as atmospheric turbulence, transmitter pointing errors, and photodetection noise. The diffractive deep neural network (D$^2$NN) can be used as an all-optical front end to mitigate turbulence-induced distortions before detection. However, existing D$^2$NN compensation schemes are not specifically optimized for communication detection. In this paper, we propose a supervised contrastive inspired D$^2$NN (SCI-D$^2$NN) framework for improving the detection performance of OAM-multiplexed FSO communications under these impairments. The proposed framework introduces two training branches: a projection branch that maps the optical field to low-dimensional decision domain samples, and a label branch that provides supervised labels to impose a separation constraint among decision domain samples. In addition, we characterize complex-amplitude crosstalk to obtain the receiver observation vector and formulate two detection schemes, namely single-port profile-likelihood detection and joint maximum-likelihood (ML) detection. We further design two SCI-D$^2$NN training losses called Bhattacharyya distance (BD) based loss and the ML based loss to improve decision domain separability and mitigate detection-performance degradation. Numerical results show that SCI-D$^2$NN achieves more than a 3-dB improvement in bit error rate (BER) over the conventional D$^2$NN baseline in most transmit-power regions. The BD based loss gives the lowest BER under different system parameters and provides more than a 10-dB BER improvement over the baseline in the high transmit power region.

title: XAI2CSI: Interpreting CSI with eXplainable AI for Human Activity Recognition
authors: Idio Guarino, Alfredo Nascita, Domenico Ciuonzo, Damiano Carra, Antonio Pescapé
abstract: Wi-Fi Channel State Information (CSI) has emerged as a key enabler for device-free Human Activity Recognition (HAR), enabling low-cost, unobtrusive sensing using existing communication infrastructure. However, Deep Learning (DL) models trained on CSI data often struggle to generalize across users, environments, and device setups due to the context sensitivity of wireless propagation. Despite this challenge, limited attention has been devoted to understanding model decisions and generalization failures. This paper introduces XAI2CSI, a framework that leverages eXplainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) to analyze DL-based CSI sensing systems. XAI2CSI employs SAGE, a model-agnostic explainability method, to quantify temporal, spectral, and spatial CSI contributions to HAR decisions under nominal and cross-context evaluations on IEEE 802.11ax data. Our analysis reveals that the considered DL model exhibits limited robustness to unseen conditions due to an over-reliance on context-specific CSI patterns, causing models to misinterpret the underlying signal dynamics when deployment conditions change. The proposed methodology and findings provide a reference framework to explore alternative solutions and guide the development of robust, transparent Wi-Fi sensing systems.

title: OmniRAS: Standardizing Foundation Model Training and Evaluation in Robot-Assisted Surgery
authors: Leonardo Borgioli, Neil Getty, Wenli Xiu, Jessica Cassiani, Alvaro Ducas, Carlos Agustin Orda, Hira Waris, Fangfang Xia, Rick Stevens, Pier Cristoforo Giulianotti, Milos Zefran
abstract: Few foundation models exist for robot-assisted surgery, partly because large robotic-surgery video corpora are difficult to assemble and existing models are evaluated mostly on laparoscopic benchmarks. Further, most existing models are evaluated on a small set of public benchmarks, mostly focused on laparoscopic surgery. We present OmniRAS, a family of 1B- and 2B-parameter V-JEPA-2.1 encoders for robot-assisted surgery, and detail their training. First, we release two densely annotated robotic-cholecystectomy datasets: OmniRAS-PR and a multi-label YT-Chole tool-verb-target task, the first triplet-style annotation for robotic cholecystectomy, together with splits, probe protocols, and an inter-rater study validating the shared phase ontology. Second, we document continued pretraining at up to 256 compute nodes with global batch 6,144 over 19 sources totaling approximately 2,650 hours of surgical video, 51% robotic, and analyze compute and data composition. Third, we evaluate against raw V-JEPA-2.1 and specialized surgical models on six tasks spanning triplet, phase, and step recognition, action segmentation, and detection, under frozen-encoder and final-four-block fine-tuning regimes. Across three seeds, this yields 254 downstream runs, including 109 with partial backbone fine-tuning. The best OmniRAS models achieve the strongest adapted results across all task families, while frozen differences are smaller.

title: Learning to deform the matched filter
authors: Paul Anthony Haigh
abstract: Analytical signal-processing blocks are interpretable and reliable, but their optimality depends on assumptions that practical hardware and channels violate. Learned replacements can adapt, but often discard the structure that makes the original solution understandable. Here we introduce deformable matched filtering, a platform in which learning steers a bounded deformation of an explicit matched filter instead of replacing the waveform-processing path. In a hardware-in-the-loop optical wireless link, blind state descriptors drive causal, pilotless updates while payload samples, transmitted references, and condition labels remain outside the controller. Receiver deformation generalises across held-out signalling and channel conditions and remains ahead of a span-matched fractionally spaced equaliser after stationary convergence in most tested regimes. A transferable transmitter deformation reduces error-vector magnitude in all 144 held-out evaluations, whereas its additional value after receiver adaptation emerges principally under severe combined distortion. KAN, MLP, and linear controllers provide different condition-dependent advantages within the same filter structure. During 24 hours of uninterrupted changing-condition operation, bounded deformable receivers recover their original operating regime after severe intervening distortion while the persistent conventional equaliser accumulates destructive state. These results establish deformable analytical filters as a reusable middle ground between fixed theory and end-to-end learned signal processing.

title: A Reconfigurable Pipelined-SAR ADC with Embedded Compression for Temporal Compressed-Sensing Ultrasound Imaging
authors: Reza Pakdaman Zangabad, Xitie Zhang, Levent Degertekin, Shaolan Li
abstract: Compact ultrasound imaging systems are increasingly constrained by receiver-side sampling, conversion, memory, and data-transfer requirements. This work presents a compressed-sensing pipelined successive-approximation-register analog-to-digital converter (CS-SAR ADC) for acquisition-side temporal compression of pre-beamformed medical ultrasound radio-frequency (RF) data. Pseudo-random polarity modulation and charge-domain accumulation are embedded in the SAR sampling network so that multiple consecutive RF samples are encoded into one measurement before quantization, supporting temporal compression ratios of $N_{cT}=1$, 2, and 4. The compressed outputs are recovered off chip using a probe-specific pulse-dictionary RF model and then processed with conventional ultrasound beamforming. A 65-nm CMOS prototype was measured with a 1.2-V supply and 50-MHz master clock. In the non-compressed mode, it operates at 10 MS/s, consumes 964.49~$μ$W, and achieves 44.12-dB SNDR and 56.40-dB SFDR for a 7.7-kHz input. The ADC output rates decrease to 5 MS/s and 2.5 MS/s for $N_{cT}=2$ and 4. Across all evaluated RF traces, median NCC values were 0.981 and 0.932, with median NRMSE values of 0.36 and 0.56, respectively. Wire-phantom localization error remained below 0.04 mm with no appreciable FWHM degradation. In the speckle-rich cyst phantom, SSIM remained 0.94 and 0.87, while CNR decreased from 3.534 in the reference to 2.047 and 1.379. These results demonstrate a hardware-realistic tradeoff in which temporal compression substantially reduces ADC conversion count and output data rate while preserving point-target geometry, whereas low-contrast cyst conspicuity is more compression-sensitive.

title: Bounds on Shaping Partially Coherent Microwaves with Programmable Scattering Systems
authors: Philipp del Hougne
abstract: We derive bounds on manipulating partially coherent microwaves with programmable scattering systems. We first consider the concentration of power from a partially coherent input into a single output port and derive a prototype-aware bound by combining multiport network theory (MNT) with semidefinite relaxation (SDR). We then address general coherency-matrix synthesis, deriving architecture-independent bounds on fidelity and useful strength, prototype-specific scalar refinements thereof, and fully prototype-aware SDR bounds on the useful-strength--fidelity Pareto frontier. The prototype-aware formulations account for mutual coupling, loss, discrete tunability, and static scattering. We evaluate the bounds on four experimental RIS-parametrized MIMO systems with up to 100 1-bit-programmable elements, using proxy-MNT models estimated from measurements. The resulting bounds are generally tight compared with feasible discrete-optimization outcomes. Interestingly, for coherency synthesis, the simpler bounds can in some cases be tighter than the fully prototype-aware bounds, highlighting their complementarity. Our results provide certified limits for wave-domain processing and harvesting of partially coherent microwaves.

title: Structurally Informed Connectivity Disruptions in Cocaine Use Disorder
authors: Seyed Majid Razavi, Saeed Tajik Hesarkuchak, Triet M. Tran, Mehdi Zaeifi, Amirhossein Arezoumand, Farnaz Zamani Esfahlani, Jason A. Oliver, Sina Khanmohammadi
abstract: Cocaine Use Disorder (CUD) is associated with widespread alterations in large-scale functional brain networks, yet the mechanisms contributing to these changes and their relationship to clinical and cognitive outcomes remain poorly understood. To address this gap, we introduce a framework to extract structurally informed dynamic functional connectivity patterns. We then leverage these connectivity patterns to characterize differences in functional brain network organization associated with CUD and to examine their relationship with clinical measures. Specifically, we applied Laplacian spectral smoothing to each participant's functional connectivity matrix using individualized structural priors derived from diffusion imaging. These structurally informed connectivity features were subsequently used to examine cross-network interactions and characterize dynamic community organization across functional brain states. Our findings indicate that individuals with cocaine use disorder exhibit increased integration and recruitment accompanied by reduced flexibility in the functional brain networks, with the most pronounced alterations in visual, attentional, and control systems. In addition, structurally informed functional connectivity features were predictive of weekly cocaine use within the CUD cohort. Overall, these results highlight the value of structurally informed dynamic connectivity measures for characterizing network-level alterations associated with cocaine addiction and for linking these alterations to clinically meaningful measures of cocaine use severity.
